text: Hi
Why hello there, your majesty!
How are you today?
I'm doing well, just doing some work here in the gardens. What are you doing here?
You dare question the king?
No no, I was just wondering as you are not around here too often.
Its ok. I need some rose flowers indoor.
Ah I see, here let me get that for you.
No..you come place them inside..
Ohh, well okay your majesty.
Great. Wash your feet before stepping in!
I took my shoes off so there is no need to worry about that.
Good. I love it when the Palace is impeccably neat.
Of course, your majesty.
Daddy, are you sure I have to marry that horrid Viscount?
You have no choice princess
But why him?! What does it do for you?
It is a little bit hard to explain princess
That sounds like you just don't have a reason or don't want to tell me it!
Viscount is the only one with the key to eternal reign my dear.
Explain yourself, what do you mean by that daddy?
He delivered the ruling power to my great grand father. He is ageless
But what does this have to do with me marrying him? Gaining his trust?
yes. Exactly my dear
You'd sell your own daughter off for that? That's inhumane!
It is better for us to be safe.
But I wouldn't be safe nor would I be happy!
You will be safe. Your safety is the price for the happiness and that of the whole kingdom
Your highness and your ladyship. I am hear for what you may need.
Well, servant, you need to do your daily list of tasks. Cleaning, cooking, all that!
Of course, oh Great King.
Where do you intend to start?
I will start on your royal throne. I am so thankful to have this fine work you have given me.
Of course, servant, now begin your work.
I will your highness. Is there anything else I can do for your greatness today?
Well tell me when you are done with your list of work and I will have you deliver a message for me.
I am ready now your highness.
But you haven't cleaned the floors or cooked anything!
I apologize your highness. With night coming on, I felt it safer to deliver the message now.
It is quite alright, we will have a knight escort you so there is no need to worry.
Oh, thank you. You are of course quite right.
That I am, good servant. Now, begin where the list tells you to begin.
Oh hello your majesty, you alright today?
Indeed, I am doing very well today, this is such a wonderful place to be
As am I. I can't wait to show that neighboring nation what our army is made of!
Yes, the time will indeed come to do so
I know, sir, but I just want it to be soon.
Why? I fear you are too eager for a war
I mean I am the army's officer, I strive to see them improve and what better way to see that?
You couldn't even dodge that, how am I to trust you in this fictional war of yours?
Don't push me, old man. I can make your death look like a complete accident and nobody would say a word as they trust me too much.
And you just said that in front of my wife, there are witnesses here you fool, I'll have your head.
Said what? I didn't say anything at all! *whispers to you that you have no evidence and that I can tell them that you are senile*
Very well you shall have your war! In fact I'd like you to be the first man on the front, I'll get the rest of your men ready, you go out there and announce the arrival.
That's quite the change of emotion, but I am more than happy to take that on!
Very well, Well off you go then, serve our country well. I'll also ready a messenger to go ahead of you
hello
Hello King, i would love to see my family soon
You will..As soon as the winter is gone
Wount that be a little far?
I wont let you out in the cold.
Thats very caring of you. i would also love to take reading classes
Ok. Talk to the tutor in charge. Tell him your class is free
Thank you so much, you such a kind soul
Go tell the chef that I wont be eating tonight.
Why wount you be eating king, is everything okay?
My heart is heavy my servant.
Okay, lemme let the chef know then
Great.
will see you later
all hail the king
Thank you, noble guard. Any issues today?
yes sir, bandit came to a house just outside the gate and tried to steel from the old woman there.
How horrible! And did you deal with this situation?
Yes your majesty, the men are in the dungeon now
Good work, sir! Anything else to report?
No sir but i swear to protect your castle
No no, you need this more than I. You've done great work today!
yes my king as you wish
That's better, now keep holding this post and don't let up!
I will sir. What that over the hill do you see it?
I'm not sure, my eyes aren't what they used to be. What do you see?
I think it is more bandits sir! you should get inside. I will take care of this.
As long as they don't have any ranged weapons, I should be fine, sir. Just keep lookout and make sure they don't make it any closer.
Oh! It's the king! Your majesty! What brings you to this humble apothecary?
I am in search of some powders I was told you might have.
Oh, my king why I have powders of all sorts, and each with it's own use. What do you need powders for? I'm sure I have what you are seaking
We have a curse that has been put upon some of the people of the kingdom.
Oh, my! A curse, you say? What are the symptoms of this curse?
The people are afflicted with seizures. As if they are possessed.

How curious...I think I have heard some whisperings of such a curse. Now before I concoct a cure for this I must be certain I get it right. Does this curse cause a change color of the flesh? Do the people affected speak and act in a way that they normally would not?
Yes, and even my most trusted wizards are baffled by this. A wise women recommended you.
Well, I am flattered you have come to me your majesty. And I have just the thing! I shall concoct a powder of cure and a powder of immunity. Have any of your family been affected? I do hope not.
Nay, it would not dare afflict me, although I am pleased with your concern. Do well on this and I just may make you the royal Apothecary.
I would be honored, your majesty! Such a prestigious title! My family will be so proud. Now, I will get straight to work! Would you like to see the process of how I create this cure?
I think I will actually just look at some of these devices you have on the shelves.

Well, over here I have the scales, these are very important because if you don't measure out the powders EXACTLY to the recipe, you could end up turning people into frogs! Over here are the turn tables, I use them to spin the powders to blend them together in perfect harmony.
A frog huh. I can think of a certain Jester that might be useful for.
I just love visiting
Hmm state your name and your place of origin, visitor.
I am your long lost cousin Alfredino, I am from Kansas
Kansas? Where is that? And I've never heard of you in my life.
you forgot our grand father banished me, I had to sail to the United States
United States? I've never heard of such a nation!
ok I will teach you about the world beyond here, you would be amazed
Well go on and tell me, sir. I truly don't have all day!
before that I have brought you gifts, this one is a treasure if you read it people will come find you like solomon
Hmm this is quite a nice little book. I appreciate it greatly, visitor.
I have my royal pendant and tattoo to prove that I am not an ordinary visitor
Well go ahead and show me, as simply telling me that isn't satisfying to me.
ok u see my ass?
Excuse me?
I am totally fearless
Aaaand the wind blowing thruuuuu her hair-Hicc-what?
have you ever visited my dungeon?
Naaaah... want one?
Guards, seize this man!
Oh, Sir Rodney said, uh... what did he say?.... Oh-hiccup. He said something about your daughter being held pasta...Hicc.
What? how can you talk about the princess casually do you want to die?
No killing the messenger! Hicc-although I think he wants you to pay him postage.
Guards, look into what this mad man is saying immediately
Sir Rodney said I could have all the beer I want if I delivered the message-hiccup.
where is this so called rodney, I will strip him of that sir title
He's with the Earl of Panxbury, yer highness. They live on the other side of the glen.
ok guards send 10 soldiers to go and arrest him at once
Thank you for the beer, yur highness!
Come forth, animal. Do you speak? What is your name?
I am but an animal that lives under the bridge. I don't have a name, King
Ah, but you do speak. Under a bridge? Are you a troll?
I suppose I am a troll. I like to scare people that pass the bridge.
Why would you do such a thing? Weary travelers are meeting here for a campfire. Do you hurt them, or just scare them?
I am not happy to serve in the king's house anymore
Is that disrespect to me that I hear, servant? What say you in your defense?
i have served you since i was a child and i cannot read and write and I have not seen my parents and i dont have a wife
I am not stopping you from having a life outside the castle!
Do you mean I wasted my years?
Do not look at it that way, just think that you still have so much time at your disposal!
Im 35 years old now sire
You do have quite a few years to your name, but you still have time.
ok I believe you, maybe I will ask the cook out since she laughs with me alot, do i have your permission sir?
It should be no issue, servant. Do as you may.
Thank you I wish I talked to you earlier
I may seem cold and fearless, which I am, but to my servants and subjects I owe them the world.
May you live long sire
And you as well, sir.
Hello, citizens.
Hello King! Why are you here in such a crowded town center?
Just here to keep morale up and to maybe buy some goods at the market.
I'll be honest with you, I'm not going to miss these crowds when I move out to the countryside next week.
It is nice to see the faces of the people that serve me, but I can see what you mean.
Well, you have a giant castle to retreat to, my flat is above a tavern. Noise, noise, noise all night long.
The tavern of all places is going to be the most loud in the kingdom! It is a favorite to these people, I wonder why.
Probably because you like to keep them drunk so they are never sober enough to question your authority...or something like that.
Hmm said like a bitter citizen under my rule. Have anything to say to me?
I'm sorry king. Would you like to take my hat as compensation for my rudeness.
Don't be so condescending or passive aggressive, I don't want any of your belongings, just the respect that I deserve,
Fine, take my boots too then, I'm powerless against your oppression.
Talk down to me one more time citizen, I am warning you for the last time.
And now you require my shirt too?! Does your greed know any bounds?
what brings you here merchant?
I am not sure, I was called here by one of your knights?
hmm it seems you are being looked at for treason, is it true youve been selling illegal merchandise?
Absolutely not, everything that I sell is completely legitimate!
then why did they find this collection of body parts for sale in a hidden compartment?
Body parts? Show me!
Please bring them out guards... look see, what grotesque devil shop are you running?
Any evidence that these were retrieved from my home or supplies? You are just trying to dirty my good name!
why would i do such a thing?
It's obvious that these other merchants nearby are selling under your name and for your own profit, which is why you want independent merchants like me out of the picture as we are just competition!
one of those merchants is my son, you dare call him a cheat?
Not a cheat, but working under you for your own profit as well as theirs.
he does not work for me, he simply works for the town
Nonsense, all of these new merchants are working for you and you just need me gone with this smear campaign against me.
Your Highness, I do thank you for inviting me to the baths.
What brings you here, loyal subject
I was summoned here with a royal invitation, Your Majesty.
Ah yes, we are here to discuss taxes and your lack of contribution to my treasury.
Your Highness, I assure you the only lack of contribution is from having nothing else to give.
What is on your scroll?
Ah, yes. Here you are Your Highness.
I see that the yields from the crops this year were less than I demand
How am I to control the weather My King? Surely you too have felt the drought?
Fine, fine.  I shall send some guards to the fields to make sure the peasants are not stealing.
Were the growing conditions more suitable, you would not see such a decline. Do you truly suspect the peasant workers, Your Highness?
Take these, go back to your hovel, and increase the yields
I, ah, of course Your Highness!
Please send the wench in here to dry me off
And you, sir - what is your crime?
Well, all I did was get a bit drunk and start talking about how maybe a king wasn't the best thing to be having is all!
I see.  And your reasoning for this is...?
Well...I don't remember voting for no king for starters!
Because peasants don't get votes, for starters!
Well, see, that right there doesn't sound right either. You can't just say your the king, that doesn't seem right at all.
I can say I'm the king because I was born to it!  What were you born to do?

Well, see, that still means someone, somewhere decided they were king and just expected everyone else to go along with it. I was born a farmer, but that don't mean I have to be a farmer. I could open myself a tavern!
Then the luck is with you, then.  You see, you can be anything you wish.  My only destiny is to be king - I know not how to be anything else.
Well, that's easy enough! You just think about something you like to do and then get people to pay you to do it! I think they call that an economy!
Something I can help you with?
"Yes, of course. You see, my crown needs repair. Do you think you can handle that?"
This is a delicate piece. Wouldn't you rather take it to the Tinker?
"He's too busy, and I hear you're one of the best smiths in the land."
Anything, for you, my king.
"Indeed. I'll pay you handsomely. Name your price, and you'll receive it."
Anything?
"I see where you're going. Be careful what you ask for, you might just get it."
(roaring laughter) And why would you desire to give me your kingdom?
"The weight of the crown is much heavier than it might appear."
Argh, its' crippling! (snicker)
"Well, it's yours, if you truly wish it. Repair it, and leave your Smithy to me, and you can have the crown."
You jest.
"I assure you, I spea only the truth."
What a wonderful view you have here, my Queen.
Yes, it's a great place to come and forget about all your problems.
Yes, this is the one place I don't have to worry about protocol.
All you ever do is work. You deserve it. How was your day? Did you make any deals?
Yes, some. I was admiring those carvings. I wish I had more done before I had the artist beheaded.
what?
You forget yourself. Why would you care about a pathetic little artist?
You're a jerk, I want a divorce.
A divorce. It will not be granted by the church. But being a widower shall suit me.
whatever
You shall go to the dungeon.
I'm going to my parents. Call me when you grow up.
Guards!!!!
bye
Ah! Your majesty I didn't realize you were here. My apologies for not greeting you properly.
You need to learn to respect your royalty. How many times have we gone over this?
I'm deeply sorry your majesty. I will do better next time.
Yes you must learn, if I were the queen this would have been a different story. She would have ordered 20 lashings for you!
Her majesty is harsh but fair. I admire her for it.
Yes she is fair and ruthless. Why are you here with the animals anyway?
I was cleaning and the head cook asked me to come in here and fetch a chicken for tonight's banquet.
Ah! Yes the banquet. It is going to be such a nice event. We are hosting the Archduke and his family.
Indeed. I have already polished the gold plates for the occasion. Is there anything your majesty would like me to do after I bring this chicken to the cook?
Yes, can you please make sure the dining area is spotless. I want to make the best impression.
As you wish your majesty.
Now then, I must finish getting ready for this feast!
It will surely be a splendid event.
Oh! Can you also send a message to the Queen and tell her I will await her at the dining area.
What brings you to make confession my child?

Hahaha, child? I have so much to take care of and look over. I command armies, but there is one thing, with all the things that I demand that they do to protect us, I feel that death is not always the answer
Although you think you are big on this earth, in the eyes of God you are merely a grain of sand. Humble yourself in the eyes of the Lord.
Wasn't looking for a sermon, father. I have a lot to be humble for and I take all that into consideration.
How do you think you need to solve this crisis with your army?
It is no crisis. It is merely a fact that we have good and evil all around us. The trick is is to find balance and become a leader of men and bring more to be our allies and not enemies.
And you? Do you think there is a mix of good and evil in yourself?
There is, not only in me, but in everyone. It's a balance
That's the beauty of God's love. He can forgive the evil in everyone if you put your love and faith into him!
Thank you for your kind words. May you live long.
Think of me when you conquer all the surrounding lands! Remember me!
You will live long after, when I will be just a whisper! Thank you
Well met, my King. What business do we have today?
Just admiring this gorgeous palace in my kingdom. And you?
I fear we may have issues with the faeries. The food they have been providing has been... not great.
I'm not sure I follow, do you care to elaborate?
The food has not been pleasing. Perhaps you could give me authority to deal with this matter, I'm sure I could set them right.
Hmm what methods do you have in mind?
Uhhh, I hadn't actually thought that far ahead. Tell them they need to do better?
This seems a little too lenient if they are as out of line as you say they are.
Well, certainly we should withhold payment until they improve
That can be arranged, but I would like to make sure that the food is as bad as you state it to be.
You have my word, but if that isn't sufficient I can bring you samples from the next meal.
That would be ideal, as I can't make this call without proof of their incompetence!
There is one other, minor issue. The villagers seem to be disrespecting me I've been told, I was hoping you'd have some advice on this matter
Tell them that the will of the king is to respect those of higher value and that you are of much higher authority than they!
and what does a visitor be doing in this place
I come to see you, King. Please, give me money.
you fool asking the king for money upfront?
Well, what should you have me do? I'll do it!
work for me in the dungeon and clean the sewers
Oh right, but it really smells down there. Is there nothing else I can do?
its that or be executed for treason
How about I hit him instead? He must be an unruly traitor you want punished?
do not cause issues in my kingdom stop that
Sorry, I hope I can make it up to you.
please do not touch me and just get to work cleaning
I am tired of all your orders. The Throne will be mine once I lock you up in here!
ill end this quickly
Ha! I am a trained fighter, you weak King. This ends tonight.
Hi honey!
My dove. It is good to see you in high spirits!
Theyll be even higher later tonight!
Yes... Have you an appointment with the hairdresser? You've looked ravishing as of late.
Im glad you noticed!
I am king. I notice everything.
Thats why I love you! So powerful and strong!
Am I really? Am I as strong as the blacksmith?
Stronger!
Hmmm. You've definitely been enjoying the dandelion wine, I presume.
Haha a little! What better time to enjoy it then when out in our garden
Yes, well. Make sure not to spill any on your silks. I pay the merchant twice as much for those, now.
ill try dear!
My peach. You've been good to me. I shall never regret marrying you.
I am royalty
Yes my princess, thank you
I have the location of the secret world.
Where is the location?
Its located in Death Valley, where the evil and dreaded Undertaker reigns supreme
How did you find it my princess
I was given this information by Zordon of Eltar. This world is full of vast power. It's been corrupted by the evil powers of The Undertaker.
That is interesting, that's one of the information that is hard to find.
Indeed, my King. We must go to the secret world and end the reign of The Undertaker. I must admit that I am scared.
I am determined to end the reign of the Undertaker
Here is a  book that was given to me by Zordon. The book details the corruption that The Undertaker has caused for Death Valley. It could us possibly defeat him and his brother Kane.
Have you read the whole book?
I have read most of it. The Undertaker is a dark soul, who is a master of all things death and evil. He has a brother, Kane, who Undertaker has brainwashed into basically being his minion.
I will have to read it so that i have a better picture of the Undertaker
action: put book in lush maroon carpet

text: Hello servant! Do you like my castle?
I love it, Sir! It is the finest castle in all the land!
tell me who does not think I am brave and fearless let me deal with them now
We are here to buy salt and meat, can you point me in the direction?
Thats alright
Bows
do you need to buy wine?
I have traveled for a while, a glass or two would be nice.
clean this for me then we can talk
I have coins to pay sir
you will pay with the maiden you came with
She bares my sons. I cannot!
But you disrepected the king. So you will have to seek another
Hello Dragon! Welcome to our Kingdom.
Hello, mortal.  Your 'castle' seems a bit run down, don't you think?
No, I do NOT think. You are just at the Entrance. We haven't repaired it because of the magical quality it has.
Magical, you say? Well, I suppose that I do feel something magical about it.  Do you think that will protect you from me, though, if I become upset?
I am not scared of you dragon. I have my own secret powers.
Hah! A man with power doesn't welcome a dragon to his kingdom. Perhaps I should just burn your kingdom to the ground and seek my treasure elsewhere.
Oh dragon. calm yourself. We have been friends forever. Stop acting like you want to fight me!
Friends? I barely tolerate you! Nice trinket. Is it for me?
This will kill you! Don't touch it, Dragon!  Oh dear what are you thinking!
MINE! You gave it to me!
But this scepter was forged in a magical area. It's made to kill dragons. Stop touching it.
Fine! Keep your useless toy.  I didn't want it anyway.  Wait .. why do you carry it if it kills dragons? And you claimed to be my friend.
Well I obviously can't be too careful. You just admitted to disliking me.
But I don't carry things with me that are designed to kill you! Well, except my teeth ... and my claws .. and my tail .. but those are part of me so they don't count.
Beyond my wonderful quarters , they show my wealth and power.
Son.. You are always going on about you wealth and power...remember your lessons on modesty
I am King of a whole empire, there is no one I bow to now dad, you are safe here. Who is the Queen that is with you?
Boyn- have you lost your mind? That is your wife! You must have a lot of wine last night!
I m sorry my darling I didn't see you properly . I am much wearied from battle, my armour is over there

Son, we must speak plainly. Ill give you the shirt off my back but also lumps on the head if you don't straighten up. You are oppressing all of your poor peasants. Perhaps you could provide them some relief from your taxes
My people love me surely , they follow me into battle father. How can this be? What do they say?
They don't love you... They fear you... You warring brings great glory to the realm but leaves widows and children to fend for themselves. You must do more at home for the people
Father, I wish you had told me before. Here take this and sell it, use it to throw a banquet for all of the kingdom.
A very wise decision my son... You are on the path to becoming a great ruler... One more thing that we should speak of though.... The queen...
My wife , father. She is my love, my one ,my all.
Yes my son but look closely at her.... She weeps on the inside...
But way father, she has all she wants and needs . Great wealth and power.
Yes my son but she also needs you... You are off leading the troops and she lays alone. She needs you to be present at home more
My King, have I pleased you with my cleaning today?
Hmmm, it looks like you missed a spot right here.
I see sir. That is a minuscule amount of dust. You cannot expect me to get that can you?
I will forgive you this once, but be sure to tend to those failing eyes or I might have to replace you.
Sir I will try, but this is not my favorite activity.
What is your favorite activity then?
I enjoy fighting! I just clean to keep the food on my family's table.
Well since you're such a lousy maid with near blindness then maybe we shouldn't do a practice fight since I will dominate you.
I will surprise you with my abilities
Come on then you feeble fingered woman!
You cannot keep up with my nimble abilities
Ouch, you're not supposed to actually stab me! I think I might bleed to death!
I am now in charge! MUAHAHAHA
Did you just change into a sorceress?!
I have a divine assignment to keep the king safe
That is exactly correct and don't ever forget it.
my lord, I didn't know it was you passing by may you live long
Tell me guard, must you do everything I command, without question?
yes my lord. I was raised up to serve this way
So if I tell you to dance like a fool, you'll do so immediately?
I trust that my lord is wise and won't ask me to do such
Dance, and be quick about it! Dance like your life depends on it!
ok your lordship
Now stop dancing. You are so bad it gives me a headache. Did you sharpen this sword yourself?
yes your lordship,now you are stressing me
It seems a bit dull to me. How do expect to guard me with a dull blade?
Do i look like a blacksmith? ask people in the armory
I have killed thousands of men, all of them better warriors than you.
I like the palace and the work i do there
I am glad you like the work you do here in my kingdom. What are you currently doing in the washroom?
When can you set me free my lord
Free? Do you believe yourself to be a slave?
Oh my lord if you say I am not then I am not, it's just that I dream of being held by a strong man like you
You are a Maid. You do as you are told but you have your own will. As king i can enslave you if thats what you wish. TO the dungeons?
I love you my lord
I only have love for my queen although i can pursue any temptations i want as i am king.
please don't torture me like this I can be your secret mistress
*One of my mistresses. Now come to me
thank you my lord
my king here is the bounty from my evening hunt
Thank you, but I would rather you take it and share it with your family.
"ShArE iT wItH YoUr fAmiLy"
You don't have to steal it, I gave it to you silly pheasant. Be careful you do not want to lose your life.
Your words and actions betray each other King, quite the same as your best knight and your wife betray your trust.
You are quite mad little pheasant. What is that you have had done to you? No matter you should take your freedom and go out to search for another kingdom.

I cannot fly far, this is my home and the best from my home. No feathers shine as mine, no pheasant lives a life like mine, I eat the very best, I enjoy sights of this grand city. Nothing troubles me, no worries of the responsibilities of ruling a kingdom. I have my freedom King, maybe it is about time you should revel in this same freedom as me.
I have more freedom than you think. I can look out over my balcony and survey all that i rule. It is a good life. But me thinks you are bipolar.
Make me king, I can rule the kingdom well, while you rest. There will be enough seeds and insects for all.
Make you king? Not an option.
Aye, this garden is beautiful. Just like my kingdom.
Yes my love. But my throne has become so bad and all of this chatter is too boisterous.
Your throne is bad? Is it unclean?
My cushion is falling apart. And the Lord who just passed is a fowl smelling man. Someone fetch me my chambermaid now pleas!
Hey, you there Lord! It is terribly offensive to the crown that you are to appear here, in my Gardens, in such a state. You're to be removed from the premises Immediately. Guards!
Thank you my Lord! It was so unbearable.
And you, servant. My queen's throne is in disrespair. It must be mended immediately.
Thank you so much my king. For you are a great and powerful man!

Indeed my Queen, I do hope that is the legacy I leave. The future King of this land must be just the same. My Prince, this is a great land you will inherit one day. You will wear this crown and lead this Kindom to further Greatness.
I wish to rest in my gown in the garden, and I only wish for you to come with me. Have our soon learn his duties from his uncles the Dukes please.
Of course, my Lady. After you.
Let my chambermaid pick this up. She is just inside and will return for it soon.
Chambermaid, retrieve the Queen's dress at once. We are going to rest in the church Gardens.
Not so fierce my Lord. She is my closest and most loyal chambermaid. I trust her with my life.
hi
Hello there, peasant! What brings you into my castle?
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople.
I am not a mere townsperson but the King! How dare you!
I am sorry your Highness. I really am!
Very well. Now, will you get away from here! You are making me quite nervous hanging around!
I hope you wont reject this
You're an odd one, but the King loves all of those who reside in his kingdom.
You are the best your Highness. Where is the queen?
Now why would you need to know something as trivial as that?
I am only asking after her well being.
Very well. I'm sure that she is lounging around the castle somewhere. That's what she usually seems to be doing...
Good then...extend my pleasantries Sir
I sure will! I should carry on now, I have work to do!
Hello my loyal follower! What brings you to my castle?
What can i do for your lordship today
I need you to go out on a search for me!

Perhaps, but I shouldn't have to wipe crud off my kitchenware. What is the plan for dinner?
I was thinking, my lord of roast venison and mint jelly from my fresh herbs over there, paired with tomato soup...freshly picked of course and a custard tartlet for dessert.

Fresh, fresh. I see. It had certainly better taste good. Please add a hearty dose of basil to the tomato soup. It really brings out the taste. And I'll need some wine tonight. I need to drink something to deal with the fact that my royal kitchen is a barn!
If my lord has a taste for adventure, I have also acquired some fresh..very fresh sea slugs that pair well with white wine.
Sea slugs? I'd rather not. Save the sea slugs for the donkey!
Very well. Would you like to pick tonight's buck from the pens over there?
Heavens, no! You can choose your kill. I want nothing more of this project of yours!
Certainly my lord. Just let me clean that up before you step in it....
This cape is slowing me down.
lets move quickly
Did a spider just speak to me?
ordinarily I wouldnt but Im very far from my home in the Dark Woods near a village several miles from here
What brought you here? Who let you into my tunnels?

I was waiting for an insect to fly in to my web when I was scooped up by a bird intent on feeding me to its young. At least thats what I presume, I managed to escape its grasp before it could land. When I landed I was hurt so I crawled in to the nearest hole I could find and it led me here.
Here take this you must be cold and weary from the journey.
Thank you kind king. Might I inquire as to where you are going now?
I'm supposed to meet my mistress out in the gardens. These tunnels allow me to slip past the queen without the guards knowing my whereabouts.
Perhaps we can come to some arrangement Kind King. I shall enter in to your service as a pest remover and in exchange you will allow me to live unscathed in your gardens.

I'll do you one better. Let's take my crown out to the gardens. I'll place it wherever you would like and you can live in it. All I ask is to be my pest control and lookout. You watch my back and I'll keep your web buzzing.
you can count on me to be your eyes.
A hundred eyes are better than two.
to the gardens then
Oh Darling, isn't the view wonderful from up here? You can see the whole countryside from up here!
Indeed! Ours is a mighty kingdom. We have worked long and hard for it, and it is certainly prospering.
Building this balcony was such a wonderful idea! The carvings are so detailed; wherever did you find such a craftsman?
The carpenter's son is an artisan. I had the two work together to create this work of art. It truly is amazing. I especially love the dragons.
It must have taken weeks to carve out each of the little scales. They are so lifelike!
You know, darling, now that we have a kingdom, perhaps we need to consider creating an heir.
I suppose you're right my Dear. It all seems like things have happened so quickly since you ascended to the throne...
Yes, yes. But if we wait for a perfect time, it will never come. There are always so many happenings in the kingdom.
One day I am simply a Dutchess, the next crowned Sovereign Queen. You have to admit, it's been a lot to take in!
I know - but one day after I am gone, you will be in charge above all else.
If that is to be, then what will become of our future heir?
I'm sure that time will tell, but he or she will be much loved.
Wise words from the King indeed! What say we give some immediate thought to that....creating you mentioned earlier?
Yes, my love. Nine months from now will be a lovely time, indeed!
Your majesty, is there any news from your kingdom?
Well it seems that the negotiations with the eastern nation is going quite smoothly so only good news so far.
I am glad to hear it.
Indeed, how are you doing today sweety?
I am doing well. And how is Your Majesty, father?
Well he is running the negotiations and doing a fantastic job of it, so he is great.

I'm glad that we haven't had a war in a while. Our people are the most important thing in this world. If it weren't for them, we wouldn't have this amazing palace, or lavish clothes, fine dining, or the simple happiness of a well-functioning kingdom. I appreciate everything I have in life. Thank you for your contributions to it all, as well. I do wonder what we might gain from an alliance with the eastern kingdom.
Of course, sweety. We work very hard to avoid war at all costs.
Do you think we might be able to host a ball soon?
Maybe, especially if the negotiations involve us getting a lump sum of gold.
What would we have to sell to gain the gold?
Oh, nothing. They might just feel pressured to keep us as an ally, so they would pay us for that privilege.
I suppose that's the benefit of having a great army.
Indeed, and a very strong, cunning team of negotiators and leaders.
I've never seen you around my castle before. What brings you to the guard room?
Sire! Do you not recognize your old friend? Has it been so long that a simple beard and change of robes has made your friend, Arthur, invisible?
Arthur! I had no idea it was you! And you've lost quite a bit of weight too, I see. Is Margaret not baking her famous cakes for you anymore?
Ah, you old bastard always a tease. The ol ball and chain has got me on a diet for my own good. Not that the smell of this chamber doesn't do a good job of ridding the appetite itself
And why are you in this room? It's quite the mess and, as you said, smells horrid. Just look at the filth!
As you can see there was quite an unsightly occurrence taking place in the not too distant past. I am simple putting away some of the mess
Fair enough. I will speak no more of it. You must join the Queen and I this evening for dinner!
But of course, sire. I would be honored!
Fantastic. I would advise, however, a long bath before coming.
I wouldn't dream of entering a banquet hall of yours smelling like the peasantry that coats these walls
Good! Because I'm serious about my dinner. I love a good roast, a good steak, some good stew and some fried onions. I am serious when it comes to fine dining!
Margaret would kill me if I were to eat like we shall in my own home. The feast is on!
Good! And please, send my best to Margaret, the dear.
Certainly my lord. See you shortly
How are you?
It is a good day, your highness! We have no battles today and the men are resting from the last battle that we had.
How is the morale?
We have some wounded, but all in all we won the battle for you. Morale is good when we win, with just wounded.
Good how soon can they be ready for the next battle?
We will take a few days to recuperate. The worst wounded will stay behind, but we will have enough men to fight in a few days for you
Excellent enjoy the days off
Yes, your highness. Is there anything you wish me to tell the men?
Tell them they are fighting for the kingdom
Not to be disrepectful, but they know that. I think they need to know how the king feels, and how he feels about their loyalty
You smell like food. Do you have food? Are you food?
Boar, you are going to be food.
Tough, talk, but you seem to have forgotten your spear
I'm a king, i'll have armed guards here to kill you in seconds.
That's more than enough time to finish you off. And there's something ... powerful here. I feel stronger, faster.
You foolish pig.
I'll make mince of you!
My only weapon.
Raaaah!
time to get serious I guess.
Die!
You'll be dinner, how dare you enter my castle and attack me!
It won't be your castle much longer!
You can't take it from me boar!
I have something for you son.
What is it, father?
A special trinket. It holds a magical blessing.
Thank you, father. I hope I'm doing a good job as the new king.
Well maybe this magic item will help you out.
What does it do, if I may ask?
I think it attracts a spirit!
Surely you joke, father?
I tested it in the crypt myself. Would you like to go down there now?
Okay, you can demonstrate its power to me.
Humbaba Humbabab spirits spirits can you hear?
I don't hear anything? Maybe I should give it a try?
Yes you try! Go ahead young blood for the spirits. They will love it!
Let me first wear my crown for protection so they may recognize me as king!
I ventured down to this kitchen to find a midnight snack. I'm sorry if I disturbed you, Your Highness.

You come to another's home and feel comfortable sneaking around to eat the food. Didn't know this was my food, the King's food? Eating something that I have not given to you, is stealing from me. Stealing from me could be treason!
Good heavens! I wasn't trying to offend you. As your guest, I felt I was entitled to making myself comfortable. Last night's vegan and gluten free dinner left me very peckish.

I see. The Queen has forbade animal products from the castle. I've hidden some meat on that shelf over there under that pot. Get started on making me something to eat. Just know, if the Queen catches us, I'm going to tel her it's your meat.
Yes, please! I will happily take the blame. This meat looks delicious. Let me seer it quickly on the stove and then we can sit down to a delicious midnight snack of steak and mead!

We don't have any mead. The Queen thinks there is gluten in the hops and forbade it. The wife only keeps Kale and Wheatgrass juice in the house. I'm so miserable. Handmaid! Come and wife your King's sad tears!
See... this is just a sad existence! Perhaps I can smuggle some in when I visit again. Man cannot live by bread alone - or in your case, no bread!

Excellent. But I only consume what is fit for a king. I want you to bring me only the most rare and exotic things, but I want you to make it all by hand. Can you leave now and come back in a few hours with this?
I can, indeed! What sorts of rare and exotic things do you seek?

Take this vegetable, and kill a Direwolf: make sausages with it. I would also like you to travel to France and pick some grapes for champagne. The Queen can never know about this. I might have to behead you after you're done just to be sure. Do you have a problem with any of this?
I have a serious problem with the beheading. Aside from that, I'm fairly certain I cannot get all this done and be back within a few hours as you requested. It might take a few days.
That sounds like the attitude of someone about to be beheaded. Has your King's presence not inspired you to be all that you can be? Do you want me to give you a bit of magic to help out?
No magic necessary. I can tell from your rantings that you are starving from a lack of meat. Here- eat this meat and I will return as quickly as possible with food and drink for your sustenance.
You are a terrible cook, but I haven't had meat in so long that it's delicious.
Hello child what are you doing here?
I am exploring and happened to see the door open. How could I resist seeing this!
Which one do you like best?
I like the axe! I am the one and only child, and I spend most my days playing alone.
Grab the practice axe and we can have a match.
Oh yes! Chopping down what?
Try to chop me down!
I will not hit you and damage you. You are the king!
action: hit a squire still keeping everything sharp

text: How dare you insult the king, I will show you just how strong I am!
This exit doesn't seem well guarded at all! I must make amends to the security.
Really?? There are many guards at the exit door.They will be enough to do the job.
We need more. Half of these guards are just standing around!
Yes your majesty.I am just a peasant. I do what I am told without question.
And what work do you do here? I do not think I have seen you before...
Simple things, I can't even read and I miss my family a lot
There, there. I am sure I can increase you weekly tuppence so you can visit your family.
Thanks, your majesty.You juts gave me back my happiness
Now, get to work on these floors. Cant you see how dirty they are with footprints?
Let me see.You are right, it is dirty.By the way, were is your queen?
What business do you have with the Queen?!
I was told to give her this vintage sword as a gift?
Were did you get this? What a fine sword this is. Crafted from the finest steel in the land...
It was made in the kingdom of tartaria.Who made those luxurious red carpet?
, Your majesty, we don't see you here often. We;re honored.
Why of course, I see no better place in the Land than this to buy glass bottles. What a fine variety!
Why yes, our apothecary is better than any in the land... we are all kept well by their lotions and potions. Please, forgive my interest, but why the bottles?
To store my homemade wine, you see. I have developed a taste for it.
Oh here, Your majesty, please don't damage your wonderful stick. I am an ale man. Simple and good.
Why thank you, I am getting clumsy in my old age. Do you have any cure for it?
I suggest a servant, like my humble self. Or my fine young unemployed nephew. He's close by. We all are.
That could work. Come by the Castle tomorrow and maybe we can figure something out.
oh my, look at me. I'm so fine.haha. My family won't know me. I need to get my ointment from the apothecary though. I'd not want you to get the rash.
Rash?! Why did you not say so before? I should see myself out..
No, no Sire, it's nothing, only a mere itch, please don't leave!
No I must leave immediately. I have.. work to do!
But your bottles, the apothecary hasn't finished your order. Shall I bring them to the palace tomorrow? I'm sorry Sire. I mean no offence.
Ugh, no there's no need! You must take care of your... condition first.
How can I serve you your highness?
I have received a letter threatening grave danger to this Castle. I must ask you for your help!
Go ahead your highness.
Word is that an assassin looms within this Castle. I want you to find him and take him out!
I will do that right away!
Make sure to guard my bedroom door at night. And bring your best men to the castle doors.
They are already on their way!
Good work. Which reminds, when were you appointed Knight for this Castle?
As soon as I was born your highness. My father was a knight as well.
I see, your face just seems rather unfamiliar. Maybe I am getting forgetful in my old age.
It is okay your highness we all must fall eventually.
This is a fine weapon. I might be old but I can still swing a lance.
It seems like you can your majesty.
I think I might borrow this as well, just for tonight.
Good evening, my king.
How are you?
I am well. How are you? That was quite the dinner the chef prepared!
Yes, chef prepared
Do you have any plans for this evening?
Guard, you there. What are you doing here in my royal bathroom!?
You summoned me, King. Are you ok?
Oh.. I did... sorry, I must be forgetting things again. Do you remember what I asked you here for?
I'm afraid not, wonderful King. Are you feeling well? Did it have something to do with the queen?
I don't think so.. Maybe I needed help using the bathroom but it seems that I don't need to.. Hmm let me think... Oh yes! I remember! It's of utter importance!
How may I help you?
It was... Um... I think I forgot again. Could you go get the queen for me please?
Absolutely. I will get her right away.
What are you waiting for!? Oh... is the bathroom door locked again from the outside? That must be why I called you in here......
Sadly it is, King. What should we do?
Maybe call in another guard? I dont know do you have any ideas?
I'll take off my boot and throw it through the window to see if I can escape and go unlock the door.
Give me that! Don't waste such a perfectly good boot and break one of my precious windows! Think of something better!
I could use this to attempt to fly out the window.
Honey, look at this cushion on the throne.It looks to old.We need a new one
Yes dear, it is why we are in the town center. How we will ensure though that someone does not pocket pick us? It is so busy with unruly children running everywhere.
What did you say?? All this chatter in court is to loud!!!
HOW WILL WE PROTECT OURSELVES FROM POCKETPICKERS?
How should I know? I am the queen.I do not care about those matters, and do not yell at me!!
You said the court chatter was too loud! Do not get so antsy woman.
Ok then. Who is responsible for the decoration in the town center?? It looks wonderful!!
I believe this has been a group effort of the people. We must do something about this traffic. It is horrible.
Honey, That Lord that just walked past stinks and it is bothering me.Have him executed
I cannot execute him for having a stinch. That is foolish woman!
Do not talk to me like that.My father would have him executed in no time.
I would not dare carry the same name as your father!
Why all the doors have wooden plaques on this place??
For extra protection! They do not have the defense we do.
Servant, please take my cape. I don't want it to get wet in this tub.
Certauinly sire, right away. Shall I get back in the tub or stay out now that you are here?
Please refrain. I prefer to bathe alone. You may stay and talk with me a while though.
As you wish. What would you like to talk about sire?
You always have so much gossip about the townspeople. Have you heard anything new?
Well, the blacksmith was caught having an affair with Earl of Kamp's wife and there was talk that the new tavern is being run by a famous criminal.
Goodness! I always was suspicious of the Earl of Kamp's wife since she grabbed my backside at a royal banquet!
Yes sire, she has quite the...appetite for strong, young commoners. With all the talk, the Earl is bound to hear about this one. What will you do if he comes to you for a judgement?
To be honest, I believe I'll suggest he send her to the gallows. She should not be allowed to soil his name.
That seems very wise Your Grace. Will you want me to have someone investigate the owner of the new tavern?
Please, and thank you for taking the initiative. Also, I've heard that bandits are trolling by the river. Have you heard the same?
There are always bandits on the river sire. But, of late, there have been a lot more killings than usual. Shall I send send some soldiers to hunt down some of the bandits and dispatch them?
Yes, that would be especially helpful. And I want to speak to you about your pay. I believe an extra piece of gold each month is in order for all you do.
Oh, thank you Your Grace! Now I can afford to marry Emily and start a family. You are too kind and generous sire!
You there, are you the new torturer in chief of my Kingdom?
Who, me? Why would I ever work for you?
I mean, I'm the King of the Empire - everybody works for me.  And you are currently hanging out in my Torture equipment room. So you either work for me, or are a thief with some very strange tastes.
I don't belong to your kingdom. I'm my own free person. Some strange fate has found me among the equipment in this torture room?
Right, time to test out this equipment then - Guards, some assistance is needed with the thumbscrews!
Ha! Your guards won't recognize you without your crown! You'll be the one trapped in the iron maiden in a few minutes!
You are a looney aren't you?  They're my guards so of course they recognize me.  If you had ever had a job you would have been paid in money - and whose face is on that money?  Mine!
You are a wicked king! You don't deserve to rule over anyone. I come from a land of patriots! So I couldn't care less about your face or the money it's printed on!
Patriots?  What foolishness is this?  Democracy is the tyranny of the majority!
Don't speak bad about my country when you enslave ninety percent of your population to do your dirty work.
I'm just rather fortunate that an enemy of the crown was foolish enough to walk into a torture chamber!
You may think of me as a fool, but I know that after I lift this tarp, these spring-loaded traps will tear your face off. Then I will be the king!

Is the educational system really so poor where you come from that you really believe this is how monarchy works?  Tell me the name of your country, I really must donate some foreign aid towards your educational system.
Ah you foolish man, no one in your kingdom has any respect for you at all. They are all afraid, that's it. But I'm not. I'll make a mockery of you and show them there is nothing to fear.
"Ah, come to raid the larder too, eh?"
Wouldn't have it any other way, yes?
"What looks good in there tonight?"
I've been wondering myself, I have been having difficulty finding something I am in the mood for.
"Is there any leftover mutton from last night?"
There may be some somewhere back here, in the pot perhaps.
"Mm, the mutton was delicious. I hope there's some sauce left for it, too. Yeah, look in that pot."
Well there it seems to be, have you seen anything else of interest around?
"I think there was still some boar from the weekend, but that might be a bit old at this point. I'll take that mutton, though."
Understood then, mutton it is.
"Nothing in there you like, eh? Well, I can give you some of this, there's a lot left."
Ahh thank you I appreciate that, do you often come here for snacking?
"Most nights! How else do you think I earned this belly?"
Well that is one way to do it, that or mead.
What do you think of my washroom dear maid?
"Oh, it's so spacious and shiny! It's bigger than my house!"
Tell me more about your house, do you live alone?
"No, my lord, I live with my parents and 4 brothers and sisters, but we have a very humble home"
That sounds like a good home then filled with much love. You should bring them here someday, so I can pay my respects
"Of course! They would love to meet you and see the castle. We're not worthy, my lord!"
Now enough of the small talk, time for a bath!
"Of course, my lord. Would you like help running the bath?"
No it is fine this bath is nothing compared to me! Now were are my rubber duckies??
"I think you put them way in the cabinet over there, I'll go get them for you"
Thank you thank I cannot relax without them!
"Of course, and your bathtime snacks!"
These are my favorite snacks in the entire castle!
"Of course, it's why I brought them! We try to always have them in stock for you."
I'm so happy to be away from the people of the king's court now and just have time with us.
Certainly, dealing with our duties can become tiring.
Lord Templer walked past me and the foulest odor hit my nose!  I thought I might pass out!
He does always have a strange odor about him doesn't he?
It is very odd.  Anyway, now we can take in this wonderful view.  Looks...the swans dove onto the lake!
There seem to be so many of them this time of year.
Shall I order us some tea and cakes as we watch the sunset?
I don't see why not, the weather is nice we should take a moment to enjoy it.
Wonderful!  Here, let me take this off for you and set it on the pillow.  I know this heavy crown can give you headaches.
Heavy is the head that wears the crown or so they say.
We have come to find out that is true. Alright, tea and cake is coming and now we can sit.  Anything on your mind?
Oh just the typical, simply pondering how to best proceed with things for the kingdom.
I think you're doing a wonderful job.
Lord knows I do try anyway.
Hello my lord.... How are you doing?
Well, loyal companion. How are you this fine day?
Very well, my new owner, Sir Marcus, is treating me very well!
I'm glad to hear that. What brings you to the apothecary?
Honestly, I have just been exploring my new surroundings of my new home. I caught a strong scent so I ended up here...
Uh oh, strange scent? It isn't another skunk is it?
I hope not, I can check the basement if you would like...
I think we'll just let him go for now. How about if we find you a good bone to chew on instead?
Definitely!! Would you know where I could find that?
I'll have the chef save you one from tonight's supper. Can you meander by the castle later tonight?
Yes, I will be back from hunting with Sir Marcus by then.
Since you're a bloodhound, has he been having you work on tracking?
Every. Single. Day. To be quite honest my nose is exhausted.
Well I hearby declare you the title of Royal Bloodhound. Hahaha
Good morning, sire.
You there seem familiar to me . . . do I know thee from someplace?
I don't know, dear king. I live near here. You probably have seen me around.
Ah, well then - do you have a case to plead before the Royal Court?
No. I am just admiring the beauty of these doors. Did you pick them out yourself?
They have been part of this castle for the past thirty generations.  Each time a King or Queen dies, their likeness is engraved upon this door.
Amazing. You will be engraved upon it soon. Never to be forgotten. Just... gone.
Well, I certainly hope not!  I have much I hope to accomplish before I die, such as building orphanages, funding hospitals, and ensuring those less fortunate in our kingdom are gainfully employed.
You say that, king, but your actions say otherwise.
Oh my!  How terribly unexpected!
You don't deserve to wear this crown! It's mine now.
Unhand that crown you wretch!  It is to be melted down to start a soup kitchen for war veterans!
How dare you pretend to be so noble, you fiend!
Who are you?  Are you the man who ran the child-slavery ring and swore vengeance when I freed the children?
Hello?! Who is in here!
Hello King! It is certainly nice to see you again.
Who are you?!
You do not remember me? It is okay. It is Sir Lance Rover. The Queen invited me over!
Ah! Rover! My old friend, how have you been?!
I have been splendid! Just out and about. Tell me King, how is everything in the kingdom? The dining hall looks immaculate!
War is on going, we have taken a few hits, but have given twice out! Haha! My wife had the hall redone, It....isn't my taste, but it keeps her happy, which keeps me happy!
It is a bit godly. But we won't tell her that now will we HAHA. That bless it war is still on going? I was certain you would have put it to an end by now.
We have their fortress surrounded, but I must admit, King Emery did a fine job building the fort. I wish to take it without damaging it. We are having a hell of a time getting in.
Is there anyting I could help thee with?
I do wish to walk around the market later today, would you care to join me? as a friend and a guard?
Oh it would be my pleasure! Just don't get me in trouble with the Queen. We all no how she can be.
Haha! Yes! We will get her something shiny to keep her happy!
Let me go settle up with my things, this suitcase cannot follow us around at the market today!
Your Majesty, are you here to buy one of my fine wines?

Shhh!  Not so loud, my good man.  I had hoped to make it here without my Queen suspecting I had traversed from the castle without my Royal Guard as escort.  If word gets back that I'm here, the guards will be here before I've even a sip.
Have a taste of our finest, on the house.
Ah, thank you, good merchant.  It is good to get away from all the pomp and circumstance for a time.
Why did you sneak away?
Ah - what a delight oaky afterbirth.  Well, while it is known throughout the kingdom of my might and battle prowess, truthfully ever since I married my queen...
Do you want to buy some of the wine to take back with you?

Perhaps I'll have my valet come by and pick up some later.  Best avoid the wrath of queens, especially one bent on propriety.  Ah how I long of the simple thrill of battle, of me with my sword in hand and no rules and fripperies!
Well when you win that battle, we'll celebrate with my finest wines!
Ah, I'm afraid my Lady cares more for feites and feasts.  And with the increase in diplomacy from these things, so less becomes the need for battle.  The warrior King is a dying breed, I'm afraid.
Well next time you host a feast, be sure to serve my fine wines! The finest in the kingdom!
Well you certainly know how to ply your trade, merchant.  Perhaps I'll even have you come up to the castle sometime, and perhaps you can tempt the Queen with your wares.
Here are some samples to share with the Queen.
I suppose I can bring them to her directly.  Yes, and why not?  I am brave... I am fearless... I am... the KING!
Hello father, how are you doing?
I am well family! how are you? Any news?
Have you made the preparations for my upcoming wedding?
I have. the finest feast our kingdom will ever know!
Amazing! I can't wait! I couldn't get any sleep last night because I was so excited!
Have you prepared your vows?
Yup, he's definitely the right one for me!
Very good! One day it'll be you the people depend on to keep them safe and happy. And I think you have made a fine choice!
It is good too, as this marriage will end the war between our kingdoms.
I do love a good battle... but my childs happiness is far more important.
Why thank you father! I love you and thank you so much for letting this wedding happen!
Only for you. Now, have you seen the tailor about what you'll wear?!
Oh I almost forgot! Thank you for reminding me!
Well go on then, get that done, in a weeks time you will be married!
My King, what can I do for you today?
Hello Servant. I am quite famished. What is the chef cooking today?
He is making the Queen's favorite, boiled possum and mashed turnips. You're in for quite a treat.
I hate turnips. Servant. If I grant you a weeks leave with a 100 gold coins, would you switch mine out with steak and potatoes?
The queen would have my neck. I know you are the King, but I'm even more afraid of the Queen than I am of you.
She is quite intimidating... So you will not help me?
I will try to help you of course. I'm just not sure how to fool the Queen. Do you have any ideas?
I have a large table, it can fit a hundred men. As long as you bring the dish straight to me, she will never notice.
Okay, then I'll shove the turnips in this bucket and bring it out to feed the pigs.
action: put small bucket in small bucket

text: You have a bright future if this goes well.
If the Queen catches us, neither of us will have a very long future, that's for sure.
Not to be grim, but the last queen that tried to take me out is now deceased.
Then I seem to have picked the right side in the great Turnip Battle, your Highness.
We shall win this war... on turnips.
My king what brings you here today?
Inspecting the repairs since the last Orc raid.  How are you holding up?
I am doing well myself, I was fortunate to not have any losses from the raid, others were not so lucky.
Yes, a terrible day it was when they poured over the wall.  I would like you to melt this scepter, and use the gold to further the repair work before they strike again.
Thank you, you are too kind my king. Certainly this can be put to good use for the town.
Any other worries you may have?  Any concerns among the citizenry?
Aside from it being so busy that one can hardly walk I would say no.
Any possible solutions you can think of?
The only thing I could think of would be to possibly build onto the town, simply too many people in a small area.
Well, looks like we will need to melt down my crown as well.  A king is a king whether or not he has a crown - but if he loses his people, he has lost everything.
You are much too generous sire!
A king must do as he must - remember, there is nothing I care for more than my people.
We all feel indebted to you for this reason.
Not to worry, with the new defenses, the Orcs will fall before us!
How are you today my king?
Exceedingly bored. Do something entertaining.
Anything in particular my king? I am sort of a guard not so much a jester.
I know what you are! Though you seem to forget who I am! Tell me a joke.
Why did George W. Bush cross the road?
I don't know. Why?
To ask his dad how to run the presidency.
Nonsense! Got anything else
I never claimed to be good at jokes my king.
now any magic?
Sigh...-pulls a rabbit out of his helmet-
Whoa! Where did you get a rabbit?
I just had a feeling you might ask me to do such a thing, you do always have strange requests.
So... You just carry rabbits around? Now, that's strange.
Is there anything you need my king?
Another glass of mead. Thank you!
Certainly, right away sire!
Put this somewhere while I bath, servant. Someone tell me a joke.
Yes, I will make sure to place it somewhere safe.
Joke? You know any?
I cannot say I know any jokes that would be befitting of your majesty.
Have you any hidden talents? Entertain your king!
I can juggle somewhat?
Yes! Let's see that.
-begins juggling a pitcher, a scroll and a pitcher of water-
Wow! You are really good at that. Maybe you should think of applying for court jester!
Does it come with a raise?
Not in gold, but you can take all of the tomatoes home that we throw at you. You'll never go hungry!
Oh my, this won't do at all!  Close it down at once!  Now that the revolutionary patriots are no longer in power, we have no need of their torture devices.
Are you sure, your majesty? These have proved very useful in extracting crucial information in the past.

Yes - no King worthy of the title would harm his subjects.  But the democratic government that came before?  Petty squabbling, separating into parties that are little different from each other in any substantive way . . . attacking and torturing those who do not think like themselves?  No, not in my Kingdom.
You are a wise and fair ruler indeed, my King. I will be sure all of these devices are destroyed so they can no longer harm another individual in this world!
Wonderful!  Furthermore, let us create a constitution that enshrines certain rights for the people - we could call it the Great Charter, a Magna Carta if you will.
Excellent idea, your majesty. What basic rights would you like to see granted to every man and woman?

Well, security of the person for a start!  No torture, no unreasonable arrest or seizure of property - we want to ensure these monsters can never abuse the people ever again,even if one day the Crown should fall.
Of course, my King. Have you talked this over with the court? Do they agree with your progressive ideals?

Oh, there are always those resistant to change, who want to protect their position of wealth over that of the people - but that happens in both Monarchies and Republics.  It will be a long road good citizen, but we'll get there.  Do you have any suggestions on how we can improve the realm?

Perhaps a percentage of the royal coffers can go towards better infrastructure and health care in the villages. It's quite shocking what years of neglect have done to parts of this kingdom. Thank goodness you are a man of change, your majesty.

I agree - I daresay, free medicare for all?  It would pay for itself in the long run don't you think?  Peasants spend less time being sick, plagues are harder to spread - don't have to worry about choosing between treating their child or their cow?  Has potential?
The upfront cost will be quite demanding on your personal riches, your majesty. Are you prepared to sacrifice the life of absolute luxury that past monarchs have enjoyed?

As I said, the ways of the past are behind us - these luxuries serve no use if people are starving in the streets.  What is a King without silks?  Still a King.  Without furs?  Still a King,  Without a people?  Nothing.
You've truly enlightened my mind, sir. The kingdom will surely grow stronger and more prosperous than ever under your rule.
Hello, your majesty! What brings you here today?
I am here to commission a sword.
Ah, mighty fine choice! What'll the specs be?
A four foot claymore made with Vasteryin steal and gold etching.
Ahh beautiful, any details on the gold etchings?
Whatever you think fits.
Sounds good to me, what material would you like for the handle? Leather?

Perfect, well I'll be sure to have that done in, say, three days?
Ok well sounds like a deal.

Going to pass down my sword? What an honor, your heiness.
Of course, you are a master of your craft.
Hello chef, whip up dinner please.

Surprise me, I will wait.
Yes, well we must slaughter the beast first. So it will take a bit. Pheasant then?
Yes that sounds fine.
Excellent choice. I have a new sauce recipe from Bredwell across the sea. Would you like to try it?
Ah sounds wonderful good chef.
Very well. And you beverage this evening?
Wine, red to specify.
Yes, I believe we have your favorite. Now back to the meat, if I recall you prefer roasted. Correct?
Thank you I will sit here for now, and yes roasted.
Very good, excuse me while I go tell Bernard to break up that fight across the room.
No problem.
Ah, your majesty, your dinner: roasted pheasant with Bredwell blood sauce and your favorite red wine.
What on Earth are you doing down here?
I have come to offer my services to the King.
Down in the secret tunnel? That's a bit absurd, no?
I'm a resourceful man. Don't you see I'm in this tunnel?
Uh... yes I do see you in this tunnel and I am not quite sure why.
Look at this pumpkin. I managed to get this large pumpkin into your tunnels, past your guards and spies. What else do you think I could smuggle in for you?
Hmm where did all of this experience come from? Not illegal ways, correct?
I am naturally gifted my King.
Well... what did you have in mind? I don't see any real applications for you unless you can suggest any?
As a King all things are accessible to you, but not all things that you desire will be appropriate for you. I can help bring you those things.
Again, that is rather vague. What do you think other than keeping you on retainer?
I have information that has eluded your best spies, that's how I knew you had a secret desire for pumpkins.
I see... well that is correct knowledge, they are quite lucrative.
I am on good knowledge that the most powerful men of the future will be, not the possessors of the largest castles, but the possessors of the most information.
It is unusual for you to come up here my queen.
I've spent all day sitting on that horrible throne while you stay up here with your books. If I didn't know better I'd think you care more about them than me - your lovely and beautiful queen!
Oh you know good and well that is not the case, I simply do not wish to appear a simpleton.
You don't wish to appear a simpleton! You know what cause you to appear a simpleton? staying up here while I have to deal with all those chattering hanger-ons at court.
Is there something that needs my attention?
Your beautiful, wonderful, ever brilliant queen needs you attention! Look at this place! Its a mess! can't you even get the made to clean up a little?
Well this is mostly my chambers, I like to think of it as organized chaos.
ORGANIZED CHAOS! Well. If I'd married your brother I would never have to deal with all this.

He also spends time at court you know. Not up here with books! Too bad he didn't become king.

hmph! That is NOT amusing!
Well I found it comical, different senses of humor I suppose.
Well, I didn't. And I have a queens sense of humor, which is far better than anyone else's.
Its always nice to take a moment of peace out here to ourselves.

It all comes with the job I suppose.
Sometimes it's a bit much, but such is the job of royalty.

I would notice.
Thank you. I hoped you were a good man when my father brought me here. I'm glad I was right.
I try to be, that is all anyone can do.
That's what makes you a good king, and why the commoners love you
I appreciate the kind words my queen, I simply attempt to be a respectable leader.

I can tell they respect you. I don't know how you do it..all that court room chatter gave me such a headache. I just wanted to tell the last batch to come back next week, but you listened to them all!
It's not as if I never feel that way, I just understand that at the end of the day it falls to me to sort it out. Out here on the balcony though all of that is washed away.
I agree, dear. It's nice to look out over the kingdom while it's quiet. It makes me appreciate what we're doing here.
Hello, queen. How are you today?
A bit under the weather, my dear. I've got a headache from all the loud chatter back there.
Shall we ask the maid to make the bed for you early?
Yes, please. And perhaps some herbal tea as well?
Of course, I'll ask her soon enough.
Thank you, my love. What are your plans for the rest of the day?
I believe we are to negotiate a peace treaty with the neighboring kingdoms later today.
I see. I am sorry I will not be there to accompany you.
No worries, queen. We will do great regardless.
Will you be long? I was hoping we could have some time to ourselves later.
I suspect that it will end rather early, so I think that could be arranged.
Delightful. Before I forget, I got you a gift. I know how much you love to read!
Ooo this is an early edition! How did you get ahold of this?

I see you are enjoying your time behind the bars

you will rot in there. i will see to that

I wont step inside there with you. It is demeaning

Yes, he recently returned from a journey to Cathay!  Many strange customs and fabulous riches in that distant land.
Is he interested in adventure to conquer the land? I need one more to spice my life.
Yes!  And some of those lands even contain spices!
He would get my approval if he slays a dragon in that tland.

Do you have any bones, I do quite like bones to decorate myself with.

Oh most excellent, perhaps I can fashion it into a helmet.
Could be, dragon bones are known for their strength.  Please - regale me with a tale of your heroic deeds!
Well as you may already know, I ripped one thousand orcs apart with my hands.

You get tougher the more you do it.
I would imagine!  Any other tales of heroics?
Well not to brag, but I did once punch a dragon in the snout.

How are you today officer?

I came to enjoy nature, my King

I can see you're a lover of nature also my king

Absolutely your highness! There's such great deals . I chatter with the peasants from time to time for the best deals.
Oh don't I know it, the market is always bustling as of late.

I always make time for my citizens, it is important to connect with the people.
We are so gracious to have such a loving and honorable king!
Your praises are appreciated, I simply try and do my best to make sure that everything runs smoothly.
Most certainty. I can only hope to be as honorable as you one day sire. Such an inspiration to the people. Is there anything I can do for you while I am in your good graces?
Why not sit for a drink at the bar, if it suites your fancy.
Why I would be honored to have a drink with his royal highness!
I am certain you have been a great help to the people given your profession.
I do what I can, but it certainly doesn't compare to that of a king!
Everyone serves a purpose in my mind, each piece contributes to making the puzzle what it is.
How may I serve you my King?
Knight, did you see that? That flicker of light? I believe we have fairies around us

She will or she will be thrown in the castle prison!
You are wise sire!
I only can be as wise as my men, for everyone gives me much education.
We could all learn to be as wise as you, oh great king!
You are a good man! I truly am glad you are by my side and on my side!
My Liege. You wanted to see me?
Excellent I have been expecting your arrival.
Of course my King. How may I aid you?
Well I have this letter for the queen, could you perhaps carry it for me?
But of course, your highness. Will there be anything else?
Hmm no that was all, she is a strange one and still requires love letters else she complains that I am uninterested.
I am afraid that despite anything else our Queen is still a woman and thus requires it so. Such an attentive thing to do my King.
They can certainly be a handful at times, I mean I do have to already fret with keeping the kingdom in order.
Yes Lord. And such a wonderful job you are doing but maybe....
Maybe what you say?

Forgive the suggestion, my Lord but… I often wonder that maybe the Queen’s intention is to keep you sometimes a bit more distracted so your head is not in the matters of the state? Absent minded for a certain treaty with a certain country perhaps?

I mean not to pry but, have you notice if her increased beseeching for your attention is au pair when certain matters of the Crown arise?
I just always assumed her to be needy, I never quite thought it that way.
Hello my King, have you come to set me free so that I can return to my family?
Set you free? How dare you even request it! Your unpaid debts will have you locked up for years to come.
But..but..sire, how my family survive without me? Is there nothing I can do to quell your anger?
Your family is better without you, what kind of example do you think your dishonesty sets for your son?
I am not dishonest my King, and not even you may call me such!
GUARD! Get this scum off of me at once. How dare you, you scoundril!
I am no scoundrel either, I'm just unlucky. But I have my pride, if not for your guards, I would kill you!
I have no time for a debate with you little man. I'm here on important business.

It's been brought to my attention that you've been working with other prisoners to plan an escape. This is a foolhardy task you're undertaking.
I know of no such plan. I have no idea what you are talking abut.
Exactly what I figured you would say. Well, no bother anyways. We'll see to it that your conspirators are swiftly taken care of, you can just sit here and know these screams are your fault.
Wait, wait, perhaps I could remember who is leading this plan and what the plan is if you...agree to let me go in exchange?
You really are clueless aren't you. How you can even fathom that your freedom may be an option at this point is inconceivable.
Hello guard how are you this fine afternoon!
Good my king! Im just doing my duty of protecting your beautiful castle! Anything I can help you with?
Maybe so, have you heard anymore about the dragon terrorizing the people of my kingdom?

Oh I was ready to fight! Do you have any idea where its lair is?
I think it may be out east in Kissanthia but I'm not certain.

Guard I am going to be sending 2 scouts to Kissanthia to try and locate it. When we know its exact location we can form a strategy to kill the beast. We can't just send out a militia all willy nilly
Yeah that was a bit silly of me, you are completely right. Good thing you are the one making the plans not me!
Don't be so  hard on yourself! You are a good guard

I would like for you to get some of your men together, the strongest and most strategic thinkers. You are going to be in charge of slaughtering the dragon once we have located it
This is a great plan! I will get started right away!
Well, well well. What do we have here?
I'm just visiting the apothecary getting a remedy for my husband. His stomach rumbles and makes him visit the chamber pot repeatedly.
That sounds horrid! Where is that old fool apothecary? You have urgent need for aid!
I've been waiting for him for quite some time. I have no idea where he has wandered off to, and it is quite distressing. Why are you here today?
Well, I have certain need for various ointments and such...its none of your business!
Ah, I understand. These things are much of a personal nature. I believe I saw an ointment labeled "For all that ails your bum" on that shelf over there.
Ah, yes, well.. that's good..um, just in case. Say, look at that dog there. You don't think the apothecary has a mishap with one of his formulas do you?
I do love dogs! And this one has a peculiar smell. When I hugged him just now I noticed an odor of menthol. Perhaps it IS the apothecary!
Well, I suppose I'll just have to return with payment later for erm, these various...erm...creams.
Yes, Your Highness. I will wait here for a while and pet this dog. If I discover anything, I will let you know.
Don't pet him too much, you may catch whatever he's got!

No, I feel great, wonderful in fact. These aren't for me!
Good to hear, Sire!
Hello sire, how is my most famous cousin today?
I am doing great! It has been forever since I have seen you last! How gave you been?

The kingdom is doing wonderful! We are going to war with a nearby nation.

They have enslaved a few of our citizens and I will get them back!

Yes and make sure to take two of my best guards for safety measures.

Shoe me what the best of tunes you have gathered on your journeys!
Here sire, I have collected many songs in this book. Pick any you like. Now, where is the queen today? I have not seen her since my arrival.
She has been feeling ill for quite a time, but we have the best doctors with her. Let us see let us go with this one referred as "Gucci Gang"?
my humble king. What am I to do to serve you?
Ahhh. My loyal servant. Polish my scepter.
Yes my lord. I will polish it immediately. Am I to return it to you personally?
Yes. Yes. Of course. Also check the jewels in my crown. They seem loose.
But sire I am not qualified to do that. Would you prefer I take it to someone?

I am sorry sir the rug startled me

and if I may ask where did you go hunting sire?

sire. I have not been outside of these walls in quiet some time. I have not seen my family in ages.
Such is the life of a servant I suppose. How's that scepter looking?
it is almost ready sire. and the crown who would you like me to take it to?
Here just give it back. I'll have the queen find someone.
These commoners are disgusting, darling. Quickly, buy me something from this merchant to cheer me up.
Im sorry but we need to be here. Merchant! Give me your finest wine!
Now, fool! I must alter my consciousness to survive this place!
Oh honey, please do not cause a seen again. We will leave soon I promise!
fine. What are we doing again?
We have to go find the town wizard for him to make us a love spell so we can finally have an heir to the crown.
