I mean... Its worth a try right? What else do you expect me to do?!
Of course, you are right. Though there is always adoption?
Adoption!? What lowly soul would be worthy of adoption from us?!
Or, perhaps there is another way. Merchant! Like what you see?
WHAT! How dare you! Merchant, look away or I will have you executed!
Oh, my. I am so embarrassed. What was in that wine?
I'm the one that should be embarassed! I can't even please my wife!
I wish you to lead the embassy I am sending to the Orc horde.
My Lord, as you wish. Please tell me the detail of this assignment so that I may fulfill it to the letter.

Okay - you know how the last two embassy resulted in beheading and dismemberment as soon as the envoys arrived at their camp?  I'm thinking we try giving them some gifts to break the ice - what do you think?
That seems like a sound plan, my Lord. By your leave, I was thinking that a gift of food might not go amiss. What do you think of bringing pens of chickens to sate the orcs' bloodlust?
action: drop a pen for the chickens

text: Yes my friend - whatever you think will help make this venture go smoothly.  Are there any other gifts you might recommend?
Orcs like shiny objects, my Lord. They need not be too expensive, but the shinier the better.
We must be sure - not only the Kingdom, but quite frankly your head is potentially riding on us succeeding with this embassy.
Have you met many orcs, my Lord?
Only the ones we captured during their raids.  Creatures as dark and foul as we are fair and just.  Pain in others bring them joy - they once flayed an entire village just to hear them scream.
Could we find an intermediary? Perhaps a giant or a half-troll to act as a guide? I know there are many such who live in the kingdom. Perhaps they could explain orc customs, my Lord.
I trust you fully friend - whatever you need, I will vouch for it personally, the council of nobles be damned.
I think I will look to the history books, my Lord. Your illustrious ancestors had many dealings with orcs, not all of them bloodly. I will research to find a suitable solution.
Speak plainly friend - do you speak of the legends of our people?

No, my Lord, of the accounts of the lives and deeds of your ancestors whose portraits line this hall. These kings of yore dealt with the orc plague and their histories may give us clues for the present.
I shall protect your life good King as you use the lavatory!  You may defecate in peace knowing that I guard your royal rump!
Don't be absurd!  I have my own private lavatory.  Defecation is not the reason i have followed you here.  I have a job for you.

I need to you to seduce my wife, the Queen.

Why must everyone test my patience! Are you denying my request?
No my liege!  You have my sword, and I shall do anything you command!
There are rumors that you are the most popular guard with the tavern wenches.
Well, I don't like to brag, but . . .
Perfect!  I have my suspicions that my queen may have a wondering eye....
Hmmmm, what do you need me to do exactly?

I shall!  Anything else your grace?
Yes. Hold this!  I've changed my mind about the privy.
Nothing like a bath wearing but my cape. What news do you bring?

No NEWS???

You get to sit in a nice hot tub and relax while people serve you. I pay you taxes out of the little wages I make. You may decide everyones fate but you don't have it rough.
You dare imply your King has it easy? This is treason... I can have your head for this. I was appointed by God himself!

I am having the worst day, I apologzie king. You are my lord, I could just use a saoking in the lovely looking hot tub. I would never want to be king, much too much responsibility, it would be a lot to handle.
This is mostly unusual... but you are indeed a beautiful subject. Here you can have the tub.
I am sorry to give you the wrong idea, I wanted to get in there myself. I would not want to defile the king.
Oh you deny your king? You tease and deny? I will now have your head for this! GUARDS!!
No please! I have just never done that before, I want to be an honest woman.
Woman! Ew I thought you were a beardless man! GUARDSSS!!!!!!!!!
What is this, I am so confused my king, you are gay?
Torture him some more until he tells me the secret weapon!

Do anything you want but spare his life!
Until he speaks you mean?

I still cannot believe Reginald would stoop to doing such a thing, tis a shame.
me either! Can you check my scepter? Does it still have the elixir? I don't want him to steal my elixir too
It does still appear to be there sire, what does it do anyway?
With the elixir, I can have eternal life. It is the one that keeps me alive all this time. I rather him fight me one on one.. such a coward!
Do you just take periodic sips or something?
yes... I think we need to do something more to make him speak! I don't have all day!
Speak you!

club like weapons consisting of a shaft with an attached ball

it will cost 1000 rupees.  Can you afford the cost

I can complete the task for 500  wood is doable

it shall prepare them accordingly

Lobster bisque, if you need something else I can.

I would think so.
Excellent.  Well, thank you for he bisque.  I should probably leave you to your work. Don't want to micro-manage or get in the way, eh?
Good sire. I'm glad you have met me here. I have uncovered a plot against you. I overheard it in the marketplace as I sold my vegetables a town over
How do you know the existence of this tunnel?
My family has supplied the king with vegetables for many years. In times of war and blockades we have used this tunnel to deliver fresh food to the castle.
I see. What is the plot about?
It is dastardly. They plan to steal all the priceless art from the castle.
Why would they do that? I guess they cannot sneak them through here, these tunnels are so small.
They plan to pose as restoration artists, painters, construction workers. You must carefully screen everyone that comes into the castle.
Thank you, I will let the royals know about this evil plan. How do you want to be rewarded?
I am but a humble farmer and servant of the king. No reward is necessary
Where is your farm located? I will make sure your belly is filled with quality meat for years to come.
Over the hill and across Old Man Barkley's stream, as the crow flies.
Good! Will you be leaving the same way you came in? These tunnels are a maze, there are about five different rooms in the castle that connect to this very room.
I will be returning as I came. I know these tunnels well.
Good. Take this cape, show it to the guards if they give you trouble, they will see you are telling the truth with this proof.
My Queen, my love. How are you this fine morning?
Dear, I must tell you. We need to have our lords take a bath more often. The stench from the youngest one is still burned into my nose.
Bathe? I thought they were already suppose to be bathing everyday.
If they are they must bathe twice a day! And I will say, my throne needs a new cushion! Someone else must be sitting on it, for it has gone flat.
This will be fixed right away. There is to not be anyone sitting in your seat. That seat is only fit for my queen.
I am sorry, King. I am just complaining....Darn it where is my chambermaid! Ugh.. Oh sorry. How was your day love?

My Queen, please come. Calm down. Everything will be ok. I sent your chambermaid down to the wine cellar to get your favorite. I love hearing what you see is going wrong. Sometimes it takes another set of eyes to catch everything.
Ah, a bottle of wine. That is exactly what I need. You are to good to me my king.
Tell me. What do you think we could do to update the castle?
Well, the animal heads are quite, um, how do I say. They are a bit much.
What. Not the animal heads. I like those. But if you want them gone I will make it happen.
Could we at least get the WHOLE animal. Having just their head gives me a scare in the middle of the night.
Anything for my Queen. Ahh here my love your cup of wine you have been waiting on.
Thank you king. You know, she is my favorite chambermaid.

Yes well I was threatened with execution if not but I overheard talks of betraying the kingdom.

Indeed, but that doesn't mean it is absolute. It would just take renegotiation to amend the terms. But this marriage is the path of least resistance, I suppose.
That is true.  I do worry about how she will treat the servants... some say that she is a horrible woman to those below her in status.
I will keep her on the tight leash then. I may be obligated to marry her, but that doesn't mean I have to love her.
Oh Father!  That is so true.  What would the other options be, should you choose not to marry her after you have met?
There would have to be other concessions. Perhaps secession of our southernmost states to their kingdom.
But that is where our best wine grapes are grown!  It's so sad that we have to give up such beauty.
The other alternative is even more discouraging. I would have to wed you off instead to their crown prince.
Dear king, I found this over by the shrubs.  It is a great day, isn't it?
My queen. A great day it is..  Wow, this is a great find

Lets go *climbs on horse*
Move!

I will check it out, but my most pressing matter is the rumors spreading around here. They say my queen is having an affair. Have you heard of such?

Now why would your wife take such a risk. You are not a man to be messed with and it does not seem that she would take the risk. Why don't you have a seat and have a glass of wine here in the tavern. You might find a the one wine you like and will know what to buy when you go to the shop.

Will you watch my back and keep your ears open and come with me? I must get down to the bottom of this.
Where are you going to go? Do you have a lead?
Maybe I can just drink and keep watch out here!
Who are we watching for? What does he look like or do you even know. I think you have lost your marbles.

I cannot leave her, but I can take both the adulterer and adulteress heads!
hello my king

nothing much is there anything i can do for you my fair king

i think if we plant more of these it will make the ambiance much better

I....will do my best, your majesty. Bad bout of food poisoning?
Likely a combination of wine, lampreys, corn, and peanuts.  I mean, I know I'm a man of great girth, but one of the bathtubs is nearly full as well.

Goodness, I'm scared to even look. I only have a single towel with me.

that abominable lord that went past smelled.. well.. he smelled abominable! CHAMBER MAIIIID!

GOOD!  do it forth with! what the hell is wrong with this chair? chamber MAID!

chamber maid! CHAMBER MAID! chumbrmerd!!

that is annoying. The cleaners are to be blamed. I saw some of them trading it for gold yesterday

yes your majesty...may I inquire of your health my King?

Sir, my king has been very busy and has directly sent me here to cooperate with you to avoid any future wars. I think we both know who would be destroyed if a war did happen.
ENOUGH! Guards, apprehend this man.

It is a very sad place. I do what I can to survive and this brings me a small pitence to feed me and clothe me.
All of this equipment used for hurting people. This equipment with no mind of their own.
It is happening in your kingdom my lord. You could do whatever you want, if you wanted to abolish this torture treatment you could. But that is highly your decision alone.
We need this equipment though because we have people who are not upright citizens. I wish we didn't have to use this equipment.

I believe you do not have to use this line of torture. You could have them do manual labor that supports your kingdom. If anything is in ruin or needs repair they could pay off their debt doing this kind of work. This would make the respectable.
Manual labor you say? You have bright ideas, my dear peasant. What's your name?
Galaph. I do not know if I have good ideas. But I know that torture teaches nothing to anyone.

People just want to be treated fairly. If they break the law, they will learn that it be to give back what they have taken in hard work. Repay their community by keeping beautiful and well oiled!

Making sure that we have enough. I sense a massive battle brewing, and we'll need plenty of weapons.
Oh, KING!  I'm sorry for my impertinence, I did not realize it was you.  I would never expect you to come to my humble shop.  We are on schedule your highness.
Well, I'm glad that you're a blacksmith and not a watchman. If I'd come in here like this, I could understand not recognizing me.
Yes your highness.  I hope you can forgive me.  I wasn't looking at you, sir.  Is there a special task you have for me?
I'll need 3000 swords, 1500 shields by next week. I'm sure you can't pull that off, so I'll be sending a company of 'smiths to help you out. They should arrive later this afternoon.
Thank you for the help your highness.  You are a good and magnanimous king.

Good man! I swear, the things I have to put up with, sometimes I envy people like you, who can go to work and then just go home and forget about it at the end of the day.

I don't know king, what if one of your guards tells the queen?

I am expected guests tonight. I believe a sauce for the duck is appropriate.

I am expecting the regent of the neighboring kingdom and his entourage - 14 guests.
That is quite the delegation! We will make sure everything is fresh and seasoned to your liking.

But, but.. the duck isn't ready yet! We still have one hour to go.

Minced mouse pie with elderberries. Just as you requested!

Of course, our appetizers of boiled eggs with creamy lizard sauce are ready on the table

oh sorry, I mean't to say minced chicken. My apologies!

Please do tell my husband

What is it you have come for here in the garden?

Of course not, my Lord!

It is potatoes, my Lord...however, it seems most have developed the blight. This has been hard on my family and I, which it seems has driven me to my inebriated state you see me in now.

Man, this only an temporary obstacle. Having problems with a much needed crop will pass. There will be another season and that could be better. You can predict the weather and how it affects your crop and you cannot predict the insects that destroy your crops. Drinking is not your solution.
You are wise, my King. Thank you for the advice...this is true.
Do you have a wife and family? And what is they do while you plow and sow seeds in your field.
I do me Lord..I have a wife and 5 kids. All boys. Me wife cares for the younger ones, whilst the older ones assist me in the fields most days. It is very helpful having good, strong boys.

well, I think that it is only right - and good for the kingdom - that we hold them to the highest standards.  Both of our tables are furnished to some part with their food and it would be remiss of me not to demand the highest standards when it comes to the King's table, don't you think?

You are hungry? you should go find a meal to eat
Yes I am very hungry. I could not leave my nest because people are going to take my babies.
Is there a way I can help?
Can you bring me some worms? So I can give it to my babies.
You dare send a king to go search for worms?
Why can't I? You are the king of this country, you should help anyone who needs your help isn't it?
It is very disprespectful
No one else is going to help me. My babies and I are starving and going to die from hunger. So king, please help me! I really need your help.
let me help you get some then
Thank you very much king. You are such a nice king.
I just hope this will suffice for your whole family
That's a lot of food. My babies will be very happy when they see these.
You are welcome.
My friend, how are you?
I am the king how dare you address to me like that, you should kneel before me
You don't recall your old friend? I come visit when I am here.
Oh, you old man of couse I remember you, I almost had you decapitated you have changed a lot, lets have a drink of ale
You scared me for a second.
I almost had you killed, no kidding here, I almost had you hanged like this prisoner, take a look at him his living on borrowed time
Yeah. I see you make friends so easily now.
Its good to have you here, tell me about your travels old man,
Ah. Well, I come from Renfeld where I had a marvelous dinner of stuffed squid. Really good.
Sounds tasty, I never liked squid but maybe I will give it a try again, Renfelds king is my friend
I never knew. I should have dropped in. But then again, he probably would have put me in here.
Yeah he doesnt like unknown visitors either, he could decapitate you for that, I am a lot more mercifull than him
Definitely.
I love torturing prisoners, the king of Renfeld would love to be here
Hello
Hello there Prior, what brings you to the famous Tempior Market?
I am here to pray to the gods
At the market?  That seems a bit peculiar.
The gods are everywhere ... Don't you know that my Lord?
Yes, but why come to the market to do so?
The church is present in disarray
If I didn't know better, I would say that you were here only to sample the wine.
Hahahahaha. . You speak the truth my Lord.
I know that is my purpose - some Dorwinion Red will do nicely.
Wew. .the congregation must not see me with this
That was a good year!
We were blessed indeed
And I mustn't forget the Ales!  How does that song go?  "You can keep your fancy ales . . ."
How are you doing today maid?
Very well my King. I am in here cleaning like I am supposed to do.
That is good to see, the last maid was always lax in her duties.
I must do what I must to keep food on the table for my family.
That is an excellent way to look at things, if only all did so.
Yes, my King. I must say, I don't particularly like cleaning, but it is my job, so I try to do it well.
If it were your choice, what would you do?
I would much rather enjoy cooking in the kitchen. I always enjoyed helping my mother in the kitchen growing up.
So cooking is your passion? what do you like to make?
I like baking bread and treats, and cooking steak and potatoes, and I could go on and on. I love cooking anything and everything!
And would you say that your talents could be better put to use in the kitchen?
I wouldn't say better. I work my hardest at whatever I am asked to do. It would make me happier though, so maybe?
Hmm perhaps you should try making a meal then, it's not as if you could not be reassigned.
Thank you my King! What would you like me to make you? I want to impress you with my excellent cooking skills.
What is going on here, servant?!
Ack, you startled me.  Everyone is gathered here to see your big speech.
The guards are preventing people from entering. Something is not right here....
I had heard whispers that they were looking for a bandit who was trying to get in here.
A single bandit? This appears to be like something was being plotted against me.
I could not say my liege, I fear speaking out of turn.
Do you know the plot?!
Know it, I planned it!
You?! Why?!
Your men brought me to this strange land as a child and I haven't seen my family since then. I have plotted and waited until the perfect moment, and here it is. You will pay for your crimes.

I give rules, and you follow them, servant! You are no exception than all the others here. You think you can get away with this? Kill me now, and you will never see your family again and that is a guarantee.
Your threats mean nothing to me now, I have nothing to lose.
Except time with family! I am the King of the whole empire. I will not be killed!
You are no king, you are a sham.
What a grand Kingdom we have built! Sometimes I come up here just to admire the fruit of my hard work.
We have a beautiful kingdom, my dear. I would expect nothing less of you - you demand only excellence.
Indeed, I have no patience for mediocrity. Unlike the last King!
The less said of him the better. Did you just smell that man who walked past? Disgusting. My nostrils are offended.
Now, now. He is merely a hard working servant. He smells of labor and good work!
Fair enough, but can't he smell of good work and soap?
I suppose we must increase his wage so he can afford such a luxury.
Wait, WE have to pay for HIM not to smell? Well, forget it. I'd rather just hold my breath.
You are getting far too coddled living in this Palace. I ought to send you on a trip to the Market square.
Oh, dear, please. I'm just grumpy because this cushion gives no support for my back. I apologize for my bad mood, I am simply in a little pain.
I shall have that cushion replaced first thing tomorrow! What pains you dear?
Thankyou, my love. You care for me so well. My spine pains me terribly, lately... standing for 30 minutes a day is surely too much for a woman of my position.
Of course, you must get more rest nowadays especially now that we have a son on the way.
Perhaps that is why my back hurts so much. This extra weight is doing my no favors, and frankly I could use a foot massage. Call a servant, will you?
Hello, your majesty. What brings you to the garden?
I have to make a tough decision and have came to ask for your help.
Please tell me what the problem is. I will of course help if I can.
I have been warned about an impending attack, but I do not trust the source.
Well, it would be wise to at least let your guard know, as well as your soldiers so that they can be at the ready just in case.

Of course. I have done that much. The issue is: if they are telling the truth, and I don't attack first, a lot of our people will die. If they are lying, and I attack first, a lot of their innocent people will die.
Yes, that is a problem. You can station a few of your guards at the borders of the kingdom, at all directions to keep an eye out. And if they see anything suspicious then you can attack
Tell me townsperson, do you know much about these glass bottles and what is inside them?
It would appear to be an apothecary table sir, I do not know what is inside.
I was hoping you did. I need some miracle potion to save my dying son.
Unfortunately I came to see the apothecary myself, I am unsure where he might have gone.
I wonder the same thing. He is bad at his job if he isn't even here to sell.
Maybe some important errand took his attention, what is wrong with your son sire?
He is alive but will not wake up from slumber.
No sign of movement?
None, he also is sweating a lot. I fear I will lose him soon.
A fever of some sort perhaps?
Yes a fever. I tried putting him in cold water but it did not help. Do you have experience with someone who was ill like this?
I am no doctor by any means, I simply went off what you had described. The apothecary should be able to take care of it I would think, whenever that may gets back here.
I see, What are you here for?
A simple tonic to help my son be less of a rascal, something calming.
Hello my king.
Good day.  What brings you to my castle?
I had heard you had need of someone to shoe the horses?
Aye, the last blacksmith was to keen on my wife so he had to be replaced.
I see, what a foolish mistake on his part.
Are you a foolish man?
I would say not my king, certainly that would be a mistake.
How much experience do you have shoeing horses?
A good bit sir, I have worked for a smithy most of my life.
I like you.  I can tell good people when I meet them.  I have a good feeling about you. You can start morrow.
Thank you kindly, I will come before the sun rises and await instruction.
Do you not need room and board?
I would feel horrible to intrude sire, I do have a small hut an hours walk from here.
No intrusion, I expect to keep my workers close.  I shall have a room prepared for you posthaste.
Hello, kind, handsome and mighty king. How are you today?
I am wonderful, as the country is wonderful. What brings you to my dining hall, guest?
The food smelled so good, sir, I simply couldn't help but follow my nose. And you? Why are we so blessed with your presence today?
It is my dining hall, why should I not be here? Did you come with this other man?
No reason, sir, I was just curious as to what we owed this pleasure. Him? Oh, no. We are not friends.
Good. He is a notorious thief, but I take pity on him only because his mother was a loyal servant of mine. You should keep a tight grip on your bag.
Thankyou for the advice, sir! And how generous and compassionate of you. He is lucky you are his king, and not a cruel dictator.
I know it may seem unfit for some that I converse with the common people, but I myself believe that it is important to understand those that you rule. What do you do for work, guest?

I do a little bit of everything, sir. Fight when the wars require it, pick up trash in the streets to prevent disease, feed the cattle as they so require... I do my best to keep you kingdom efficient and beautiful, sir. Thankyou for asking,
And those are the traits which I so value in my subjects! Obedience, consideration, determination. All things required to keep our realm as prosperous as it is today. Say, are you married?
No, sir, I am not. No wife, no children, only the needs of the kingdom to worry my weary head. Why do you ask?

There is a local council of common people who represent the interests of the common people. To make them feel heard, you see. However, two of the local elders in the council passed this winter. It was a hard one, as I'm sure you know. So now there remain two vacancies, or so I am told by my royal staff.
Pardon my forwardness, sir, but are you considering me for the role? If so, it would be an honor to serve you, and the people. A dream come true.

It is up to the common people to choose you as their representative, of course. But perhaps you should consider speaking to your fellow common people and asking them to support you as a seat in the council. We need more men like you, who truly care about this kingdom.
Oh my, what happened to the Bottlery?  When I was last hear many decades ago it was a thriving manufactory.
It's workers when on strike when the old king did them wrong. I now use this to store my finest wine. Say, what brings you here?

Well, I was here to pick up a wine shipment.  I was told there would be a crate ready?  I travel through many lands with my caravans, the circuit takes nearly three decades.  I doubt I shall ever return, but my son shall thirty years hence.
And who sent you? I cannot just give this wine to someone who claims to be sent! This wine is valuable.
The King's Vinter?  I'm assuming you are the King of these lands?
I am indeed. I have multiple people pass here a day to take a crate or just a small jug of wine. People try to break in here all the time.
Well, this should have all the proper documentation.

It indeed does. I am pleased to have you here. This wine came from a vineyard raised by the finest royals. When our country was attacked, they took our precious vineyard away. This is all the wine standing from that vineyard.
My goodness!  Who was it that attacked you and why?
The previous rulers of the kingdom over years ago when I was just a wee boy.
What a terrible foe!  How did you finally vanquish them?
It was not I, but my great grandfather who put them out with his mighty army of 20,000.
That many men?  How could the kingdom afford it?
This is a whole empire! We have more willing to fight for it than you think without much cost.
My King, why do I have to marry that boy?
For the peace treaty - you know how much we need it.  Is this why you have disturbed me upon my porcelain throne?
Yes, i don't love him, and i don't want to move away.
Why not?  What is wrong with marrying one of the turtle-folk?  Are they not a noble people?
They are ugly and rude beasts.
Surely you must learn to love them, just as you learned to love your stepmother.
I want to stay with you father.
You will still be able to visit, it is not like you are leaving forever.
It feels like it though father. I'll be thousands of miles away.
Yes, but just think of all the half-turtle children you will have!
Groooosssss! I want to have normal children.
Well, unfortunately that will not be possible my child, unless you want them to continue to eat our people?
No i do not. But is there no other way?
Not unless you want us to stay at war my child.
What is that strange creature in the courtyard?
BOO!!!
Strange was definitely a good choice of words.
Aww man....Your not scared of me?
I am king, I bow to none.
Oh....Whats a king? You look like any other human except you are impeccably dressed.
It means that I stand above the other people, they follow my lead so to say.
So it's good to be king. I would like to be King. I will be King of my bridge. That;s where i live.
Are there no other more powerful creatures there? The countryside is quite nice perhaps you could look after that?
Really?! I would like that very much! Will people feed me you think?
I don't see why not there is usually always someone around I would imagine, just do not present yourself as threatening.
That will be hard but ok. I always enjoyed scaring people out from under my bridge. Do I get some sort of crown or badge to let people know not to mess with me?
Being a king is less about imposing fear than it is about garnering respect and admiration.
Yeah but can I have a crown like yours?
Come, servant. Sit here.
Of course, how may I help you your majesty?
Tell me a story, i am grow tired of sitting here in silence.
Okay, well I'm afraid I don't know too many stories, sir. Would Cinderella do?
Is that all you know? Gosh I'll tell one than.
Yes, its the story my mother told me. I'm afraid I don't know how to read. I'd love to hear one sir
Ok well i'll tel you the story of the great war. It started abotu 200 years ago.
Oh, that is a long time ago, sir.
Yes it was, by great great grandfather was king. He found a spy in the kingdom and had him executed.
Oh a spy. I hope you don't find a spy in your castle.
Not yet... just a word of advice, don't be a spy.
Never your majesty!
Tis but a joke servant.
Yes of course your majesty.
Hello merchant, it's pretty busy here...huh?
Incredibly!  45 years on the road, and this is the busiest I have ever seen it on a market day.
Tell me how much is this...uh...animal fountain?
47 Gold pieces m'lord, but seeing as how you're the King I'll let you have it for 45.
Ah well done merchant. I'll take two.
Excellent, anything catch your eye Sire?
I will look some more. Tell me, have you seen any of the turtlefolk around?
None nearby Sire, but I hear they have been raiding from the swamp at night once again.  Are you planning a retaliatory raid?
Yes we need to protect our people. I don't know why they are so confident in raiding us.
Sire, what do they do with those they have captured?  I have heard the legends from the small folk, but they feel embellished.
It depends on the crime. What would you do with someone who killed your people?
Well, in our culture we make them slave to the families who lost loved ones, to serve in the stead of those they lost.
I see, that is very generous of you.
What does your kingdom do?
Good day, sir. How are you on this fine afternoon?
I am well and yourself?
I am well, sir. Can I help you with anything today? Anything you'd like to talk about?
Have we any word from the neighboring kingdoms about my request?
No, sir. I've had guards positioned all day and a watcher in the tower, but there's been no message from them.
Hmm, we really need the assistance in dealing with the encroaching trolls.
Understood, sir. Is there any action in particular that you request?
For now we will continue to wait on the word to come back, certainly it cannot be too much longer.
I hope not. We can't wait much longer. The people are getting restless - we don't have enough resources and they know it.
Worse comes to worse, we will hold out as long as we can.
Okay. I shall tell everyone to stay patient. What else can I do for you sir?
Just rub my temples, I am very stressed.
Oh... of course, sir. Let me take this first, it must be very heavy.
Ahh thank you...sometimes it just gets a bit much.
Well hello there my king.
Hello Sir Knight, are you hear to guard me during my evening urination?
I would assume you to be safe in here my lord.
Thank you, I shall feel much relief with you at my back while I relieve myself.
I am glad to hear that my king, perhaps I should also relieve myself.
Please, help yourself - but keep one hand on your sword at the ready.
I will be sure to do so my king.
Well, I must say - I feel much better now!
I trust it was a satisfying wee?
Oh yes!  Quite.  And yourself?
It seems it may never end, too much drink.
Time to return to the tavern, and fill up then!
I should accompany you...for protection of course...
Certainly, I will even pay for the first round!
Is there a reason you wanted me to bathe my king?
There is a reason for everything I my subject. But that will become clear the less you question my commands.
Alright, I just was unsure why you wanted to watch me play in the bubbles.
You will play in the bubbles until I tell thee to stop! You should consider yourself lucky to bathe with your king. Most of my subjects are not fit to even handle my waste!
I just feel like you keep staring...
Never mind my stares. Turn on the jets so I may relax from handling your insolence or you shall face more fury than this strike alone.
As you wish sire, they are now on.
Good, that is much better. Now tell me, are there any books or some strong ale that lie upon that shelf there?
It seems to be a spot in which you could place such things, but there are none at the moment.
You mean to tell me that you did not bring the volumes of holy romances or the ales mixed with sleeping potions with you?
I was not aware of such things, my apologies....
You wretched subject! I am the giver of laws, and thou should know all of them, even those I leave unspoken! Give me one good reason I should not drown you in this deep tub water?
I have a cute face?
You sure do... But alas, I am still your king no matter how cute you are!
Ah, King Fredrick.  Thank you for agreeing to meet me here.  I know it's a bit... out of the way.  But I wanted for us to speak without being overheard by the other courtiers.
What made you summon me Dusseldorf?
Well, I've been hearing... disturbing rumors, from people from near the border from that other kingdom, Mirkwood.  And frankly there's enough of them that it's given me some cause for concern.
What have the rumors been regarding?

At first I thought it was nothing.  Some scared peasants having too much to drink.  But there is talk of a dark force... monstrously huge spiders... shadows that spread throughout the land.  In truth, only those who have stayed to the Path have made it out alive.
That sounds like quite a grave situation indeed. How do you think we should respond to it?
Well, I was hoping you would have a suggestion.  My kingdom is well know for its prowess in battle, but this smacks of magic.  Is there any in your court with knowledge of such arts?
I may be able to seek the assistance of some we do have a few sorcerers.

Ah that is good news indeed.  For if this darkness were to spread, it would threaten both of our Kingdoms.  May I propose a joining of our families to cement the alliance?  My daughter is of age, as you know, as is you fine son!  Quite the lad, he is!
Certainly, there is strength in numbers. We must make sure to protect the kingdoms!
I admit, though, between us, that my daughter is a bit -ahem- willful.  But I'm certain once she sees the advantages to such an arrangement that she can be persuaded.
Has a mind of her own does she? Don't most women though.
Ha!  Isn't that so.  Never satisfied, are they?
If only they were, things would be much easier.
Tell me mechant, are you prospering in my kingdom?
I am, my wares are going so fast I can barely keep in stock.
Hahaha That's what i like to hear. Now give me one of your best sellers.
Here take this, it is filled with goodies.
action: give bag of herbs to king

text: Beautiful! Thank you. Now you be nice to the customers, i know they can be rude somedays.
I am always nice to customers, that's how I keep them coming back.
Good man. Say, you might want to come work for me someday. Going to other kingdoms to sell?
Aye, heading out on the next ship.
Ah well where are you headed?
I heard there are great mysteries in the land where silk comes from.  I am wanting to head there.
Ah that place is scary. There are greedy men all over.
Have you met people that have been there?
Yes i chat with people that live there. They say it is a cut throat business out there. I'd be careful.
Aye, thank you for the warning.
Alas blacksmith! Bow before your King!
Sir?! It is a great honor to have you here in my shop. We have never had a King visit us!
Yes indeed it is true. I have decided to visit the city center blacksmiths in search of a sword. Do you have any recommendations?
Certainly my King. I have the finest weapons in the land. Right here is a Kingsley sword made with reinforced titanium sheets.
Greetings my king, are you hungry?
Yes, I am famished. What food do you have that is cooked and ready to eat?
I know the smell is not pleasant but our meats are very fresh. Care to try some?
Yes, the finest you have.
Very good. I will have to dice the meat first with my cleaver.
Very well, let me know when it is ready.
It is ready! Please wash your hands before eating my lord
Yes of course. Where is the wash bin in this place?
Last door in the hallway, to your right. Please don't mind any of the fights you see taking place my lord. I do not like to get involved.
Yes, thank you. I shall be right back.
One second my lord! Can you wash this meat cleaver for me too?
You really want your king to wash a meat cleaver? I could have your head for this you know
Please, no!! I did not mean it like that, I'm sorry I even asked my lord. I will get back to preparing the food!
Very well, just do not make the same mistake again.
Tell me what are you doing here?
I have just wandered here my king! I apologize!
Ok. You know this is a bad situation for you, correct?
How so?!
This is not a hallway you should know of.
I am just looking for architecture decoration in my lodging businesses.
Not anymore. I must put you in prison. You can never talk to anyone ever again.
You are being irrational!
I will explaion myslef further, you see this hallway is a secrete. No one should know of it except for myself.
It seems so harmless in here... how could it be secret?
This is where i have things transported so no one can see.
I want nothing to do with that, your Majesty...
You found yourself all mixed up in it though. Tell me who knows you are here?
I am here by myself! I venture and tell no one where I go...
What a wonderful Kingdom we have!
It is beautiful, dear. You have been an amazing king!
And you the most wondrous of Queens!  Where shall we expand our Kingdom next?
I think it's time to get ambitions and see if we can conquer the land across the sea.
Indeed, the Lizard-folk are a pagan people, and we shall bring the light of the true gods to their shores.
I hate them so much. Their people will be so happy when we save them
And the fishermen should stop complaining about their sea-raiding.
That will be quite the added bonus. I say we start tomorrow
I agree my darling wife.  Shall you lead the armies like in our campaign against the Turtle-Folk?
It would give me great joy if you gave me that honor. I can promise you we will wipe them out in no time. They'll never even see a girl coming
Then ready the Gryphon Warriors, tomorrow shall be the first day of the end of their civilization!
Yes! Soon we will rule the entirety of the lands. It will truly be glorious
What would you do with a ton of captured gold?
Certainly not waste it on the peasants. Haha. What would you like to do with it?
How are you doing today my king?
Sad, I have a confession to make to the priest when he returns.
Oh dear, I suppose even a king commits sins.
Oh so many!  It is a dirty business keeping a Kingdom from being overrun.
I cannot even imagine the burden placed upon you.
Just last night I had to authorize another culling of Turtle-folk.  They have been eating travelers on pilgrimage in recent months.
How unfortunate, surely god would not judge you for protecting your people though?

Well, here's the thing - because of the orcish blockade, the small folk are starving.  Turtle-folk stew can ward off starvation for the poor.  So it is both a noble act, and a terrible one at the same time.
I see, but at the same time they have been attacking...
Fair enough - but I never even bothered to negotiate, just sent the Dragonriders in to roast their villages.  Saved more of my people's lives at the cost of theirs.
Heavy is the head that wears the crown it seems, tough choices are a plenty.
Indeed.  So what brings you here citizen, now that I have burdened you with my troubles?
It is no burden at all my king, I have simply come to worship. It is my purpose for being.
Then please, sing a song to the gods and we shall both be pleased by it.
Enjoying the garden are you?
if I may, King. The Castle does have a fine garden, filled with blossoming flowers.
I am glad to hear that you find it satisfying, I quite enjoy it myself.
Do you need this sir? You seem to be having some difficulty managing on your own.
I appreciate it, I am getting a bit up there in age it seems.
Ages catches up to all of us. But I am sure you will be around long enough to see us conquer many more Kingdoms.
It would be nice to see that come to fruition, certainly we could do wonders for some of the heathen nations.
Indeed, if I may suggest, the Ogres to the West need to be taught a lesson or two. I hope you consider this at the next War Meeting.
I will take note of the suggestion, they have become a bit a thorn as of late.
I was sent this threatening letter from them recently, all because I ransacked one of their gold mines! The nerve of those beasts!
What did it say when you read it?
It said they would sent an assassin to beat me to a pulp! I doubt they have the brains to do anything like that.
Hmm but still they would threaten you, that is troubling.
That is why they must be put in their place, all of them!
How are you today son?
Very well, father! Yourself?
I am doing good, another day of seeing over the kingdom it seems.
And doing it well.
Is there anything your heart desires to do today?
Sometimes I confess, I do think on what it must be like to be King!
Well those are the exact kind of things that we can spend the day speaking of, it is father son bonding saturday afterall.
Were you confident that you would be a good King?
To be honest with you no, sometimes overconfidence can lead to failure. It is a constant process of self evaluation and refinement.
Very interesting.
What do you envision it like to be king?
I thought it might be exciting, being given the chance to prove yourself.
Indeed but there is always the overwhelming shadow of failure looming as a possibility overhead.
So you don't get to set the agenda?
Hello Darling! Taking a stroll out in the gardens as well?
Yes, It's such a lovely day. Do you like my new dress?
It suits you well and brings out the hazel color of your eyes.
Thank you dear. You are looking great as well today. Will you come sit with me next to the fountain?
Certainly, my darling. How was your meeting this morning with the neighboring diplomat?
Things seemed to go well. We should know in the morning if his king will accept our offer or we will destroy him in war. I'm confident he will accept
He has no other choice but to accept! It would be madness to come up against our mighty forces! And against your charming persuasions.
Thank you dear. I assume the meeting with the generals went well and we are prepared if the worst should happen?
They have been briefed to the fullest extent that I would allow. None of them know the real reason for these negotiations, and I think it best things stay that way.
Absolutely you are a genius as always. Are our sons ready? This would be their first battle
Ah, Thomas is still hesitant. He is still skittish around the horses.
Maybe he can go out with the ground troupes and Peter can go out with the knights. Wouldn't hurt to have 1 in each division
The men do look to our Royal Family in battle as a sign of encouragement. I have always assumed horseback was the proper place for them.
That makes sense I just don't want Thomas to freeze during a battle and something to happen to him
Can I do anything for you, king?
Yes, dear lady, there is indeed. I need to find a very specific book in this library.
No problem, sir. What's the book?
I am not exactly sure. There is an old prophecy that speaks of this book. But the prophecy did not give a title or author, only this location. I wonder what it could be.
I can try and find it. Hopefully I can. There's a lot of books that feature old prophecies.
Wait, what is this parchment that lies around here? I feel a strong attraction to it for some reason.
Oh that? That parchment speaks of the history of the best stories of our time.
Best stories of our time? The prophecy spoke of such! You are incredible, thank you for this wonderful clue!
Just doing my job, sir. By the way... how is the Queen doing?

Yes, of course you are. It is upon such obedience that my empire was built. Despite all my courage, I would be nothing without my loyal subjects. As for the queen, she sits there upon the maroon carpet. You may ask her yourself.
I wasn't sure. She's been a little quiet towards me lately. I wasn't sure if she disliked me lately for some reason.
Here, hold this and see if it leads to any new clues. I shall speak to my wife.
action: give parchment to lady in waiting

text: Sure thing, sir.
Lady, come over here! Quickly!
ALL HAIL THE KING! It's me! Ha all hail me! The all powerful, the almighty! I am KING.
Raawwwr! Who goes there? This is my treasure room!
Oh hello my dragon. It is I, your King. Do you not recognize me? I mean, I am wearing my crown aren't I ?
You are no king to me last time I checked....I've been living here for years.
Indeed, you live here to protect all of my treasure!
This is why I dislike you two legged creatures! I can't believe I used to even be one of you. This is my treasure!
Now now, you now this is all of mine. We have been keeping it here protected for many of years.

I have been here myself for many years....ever since I came from the far north in search of my own kingdom. I remember having dreams of this place since before I was a dragon. This is my gold. I'll protect it from all of you humans!
We turned you into a dragon for being a traitor! Then punished you down here to look after MY treasure!
Is that so!?! No wonder I hate you humans! You creatures can't be trusted!
Silly, you can not harm me. I am your creator.
If that's the case then I'll hurt your son and your legacy!!
You dare not!
I will rid the world of all of you beings! Starting with your family line!!
My lord what is to be done?
Ah brave knight. I have a most onerous task for you. Are you up for a challenge?
Does it involve that dragon over there?
You are both brave and astute my loyal knight.
I have to admit I'm terrified. I don't think this armor is going to stop dragon fire
Thanks to my utter fearlessness and unparalleled courage I have done the impossible. Do you know what your magnificent king has achieved loyal knight?
You have achieved greatness so that you can send people like me to die at the hand of a dragon
Nay. I would never sacrifice my warriors for nothing. Even one that is insolent such as yourself.
I will do my best sire. To fear is to he human
Stop you fool!
You said you wanted me to attack the dragon, did you not?
Nay. Whence did I command it? I did not you fool. I have forged an alliance with the dragons and you risked destroying that alliance.
I'm sorry
Hugs will not make up your ineptitude. In this magical place you were about to bonded with this dragon so could go forth and lay waste to my enemies.
You have done well in negotiations, my son. It truly was the right decision to step down from the throne.
Thank you for saying so Your Grac.....Dad.
Haha, the formalities do get tiring after a while, don't they?
Yes, but I do look forward to leading from the front.
You must remember that being a leader is not just about showmanship. It is about inspiring your troops to fight, and fight well.
Like stirring speeches from horseback?
That is only part of it. You must keep your countenance brave despite your pain. Fight honorably and treat your enemies as equals.
Is that what you did when you had the Pox? I am glad you survived, even if your countenance is much more ... rugged now.
Indeed. Your mother used to joke that she could read the star charts in my face.
Do you think the barbers or surgeons will ever find a way to prevent it? Could we have Pax from the Pox?
If you find it a cause worth supporting, you have the means to make it so.
In what way? I really don't think the red rooms are helping much ...
That is up to you to decide. As king, you have a legacy to think of now. What deeds do you want to leave behind?
Yes, perhaps I shall lead a war to fight against illness. My Queen Malinda will dedicate herself to this cause as well, I know it to be so.
Good morning, king! How goes it today?
Ah, it's another glorious day at the castle! Have you heard any more of the thieves trying to break in
No, your highness, nor have I seen anything suspicious
Good to hear, my man! The Queen gets so paranoid about such things. She's always worried someone will steal her jewels.
Our women folk are always nervous. I wish they would be more calm with us guarding the kingdom. And don't worry king, I am ever vigilant on this job.
And yet! Haha! In just an instant I stole you sword! All these years and I still have it in me.
Hahaha, and it doesn't take much for me to get it back! You have to be a little quicker and on your toes than that sir
You are quite the guard! I'm glad I have you working for me.
I am glad to be working for you! It has been in my family to be a guard. my father and his father before him were
Yes, I remember you father, Percy. How is he doing these days?
He is not well. I do not think he will be around much longer. I try to make his life easier.
I'm so sorry to hear that. He was a fantastic guard in his day.
Yes he was the best! He taught me everything I know!
Please give your father my best wishes. I'll keep him in my prayers.
*Holds nose* You may want to wait a moment before you come in here, I may have left a royal stink.
Oh lord! I am certainly waiting until the smell leaves! cough, cough
I really must apologize, the Chef wanted to try making a number of bean-based dishes, and well . . . you know how it is.
No I don't I try to eat as little of that as possible.
Perhaps I could get the chef to rustle up some bean-based dishes for the servants' quarters?
That is okay. The only pay I get is food and shelter. I wish I had a little coin for what I do, sir
Have you never thought about about asking for a raise?
It would be you that would give me a pay, your highness

Yes, but you need to officially request it!  You know how those bureaucrats at the treasury think, if you don't submit the proper forms, they get all huffy and say "This is highly irregular" and then take ten times as long to do anything.
Oh I see.... Thank you for letting me know. I will do what I can and quickly
Well then, I must be off . . . and godspeed for what you need to deal with in there.
Thank you for your advice my king, let me know if there is anything else you need
Yes . . .perhaps you could install some additional air fresheners about the palace?  I fear we may be having beans again tonight.
Hahahaha.... it will be a windy day!
*squawk* I wish I could fly!
Now, do stop with that. I hear it every day. We get it, you wish you could fly. But I bet the pigeons and such over there wish they had plumage as beautiful as you. don'
But the pigeons are free, and I am a pheasant slave!
Ha! Slave?! I assure you, you're free to leave and fend for yourself out there should you wish. The view is MUCH better up here than down there!
Free?  The only freedom I have is to jump from this balcony and plummet to my death.
Enough! You have food and shelter, water and warmth, and you repay me with this complaining?!
Not much shelter, water, or warmth on this balcony.  The only water I get is from the puddles when it rains, or from your royal rose gardener when he takes pity on me.
Fine. I see your point, and I'm in somewhat of a good mood. Here, let me take this off. You can have it.
Thank you, I shall be the most dashing bird you know.
You already are, my friend. Here you go, it'll keep you warm, dry AND fancy.
It *is* rather dry and fancy isn't it?
Well don't you look dashing. Here, you might as well complete the whole ensemble.
Can I be in charge of all the pheasants in the Kingdom?  The Pheasant King?  Ruling under you of course.
Sure. I have enough on my plate without keeping track of the pheasants... sounds like a win for both of us to make you the pheasant kind.
Your Majesty your son his highness has a question to ask.
Of course, my dear. What is his question?
He wishes to wed my lady in waiting...the duchess is beautiful and of child bearing age.
Oh my! What delightful news! Of course, he has my blessings. But when will they be wed?
He wants to be wed quickly your Majesty.  They are truly in love.
Yes, I was hoping you would say that! Perhaps next month, would that be too early?
No your Majesty...not too soon...ummm...maybe we should make it sooner...for the ladies sake.
I'm just happy as can be! I can't believe my little boy is getting married!
Yes my dear...well...ummm...I must tell you that the Lady is already with child.  I don't want this to get out to the kingdom.  She will be shamed and I don't want a scandal.
Well! All the more reason this wedding must happen quickly! We must prepare for the royal event.

Thank you for being so understanding my dear.  Yes...we must have a celebration and announce the marriage at once.  Her father doesn't know of the child.  We will have to forgo the nuptial evening watching.  I'll get him drunk and they will go off together.alone
I must say, I'm not exactly pleased with the order of things, but it will mean more royal blood in the family and that is always a good thing. When will we announce the engagement?
Immediately I would guess.  I am happy and scared all at the same time.  We will make this work and all will be well.  The kingdom is made stronger by this union.
We can have the wedding right here in the church garden. It's perfect, with all the flowers blooming!
And this my the apothecary
Your Highness!

Thank you! and now all my people can have medical care for free. We will fight those who dare say your should not have free medical care. It is by my word that I set this law and as so, it shall not be broken
M'lord! That is the most generous thing I've ever heard! Your actions today will bring forth an era of unprecedented prosperity to our village!
you are my people poor or rich. Everyone has a role in my land from producing my food to assisting with my council.
Why of course M'Lord! Now ,in fear of speaking out of turn, how will the Apothecary be compensated for his services?

No at all, I welcome any repsectful questions. Along with my funding of the Apothecary, my fellow council who agree will also donate to it. We will seek volunteers to work here untill it becomes successful enough to raise its own money and then those kind people will be paid for their hard work. Althought it is not perfect yet, in time it will become better and although it may not help with every alement, it is at least something I can off my great people!

You think of everything M'Lord! It is such a relief to know the village rests in such capable hands! Now, where is that Apothecary? Why I've been waiting here a good while now, much before you graced us with your presence and he is nowhere to be found. The only other life here is this dog and quite frankly, he is making me uncomfortable with the way he keeps on looking at me.
This dog is the test subject. We are in the Apothecary building but indeed, where has he gone ...
A test subject? Certainly you jest M'Lord? what could the Apothecary be testing on this dog?
Well, look around. He has many potions yet no person to test them on. How else would he know if his potions would work!

But of course! You are as wise as you are generous your Highness! Now that you mention it though, there are a few half empty flasks on that table... You don't suppose this dog could be... No, that'd be ridiculous!
Oh my, perhaps you are right. How can we reveres this. Maybe there is a book on the table
Here it is! Perhaps this book will have an answer! Here you are M'Lord!
Your highness! What is that you need this fine day?
I'm not sure what my enemy can help me with.
I have nothing against you my king! I swear!
Then why do they say you are my enemy!
Who would say that! I have no grudges against thee
Oh but I believe thee is my enemeee!
How do you know, when I vehemently deny before you
You have enemy written all over your!
Oh shoot! I forgot to wash today! I hate it when the villagers write all over me!
Oh those sneaky villagers....Say what are you doing here if you aren't my enemy
I am looking for things to collect out in the sun. I have to make a living
You are a pretty tan. I can tell you stay out in the sun a lot.  I'm hear speaking to my loyal subjects. .Are you one..enemy?
I am a loyal subject!
Kiss my feet then!
Your king greets you, peasant!
Peasant?  I always did say you needed glasses.  I am your cousin Myrtle, your aunt's daughter.  You always invite me to visit once a month you silly old fool.
Ah, Myrtle, I knew there was a drunkard nearby somewhere. How is my dear aunt?
Oh, you know her - she hasn't met a piece of gossip that was too outlandish to tell.  I'm surprised she hasn't started a war after that incident with the diplomat's socks!
Oh dear, that poor diplomat. I'm surprised he recovered so quickly. Tell me, has my aunt heard anything about the general disposition of the northern kingdoms?

Well, she says that the King of Crumulis has been sleeping with his maid.  The Queen accidentally killed their stableboy during a lovemaking session on the balcony, and that their son has the intelligence and looks of a toad!  Does that help?
Looks like Crumulis is in dire need of a worthy ruler, and my kingdom is in dire need of expansion. Do you think my aunt would be interested in an alliance to crush them?

Well, she could certainly try seducing their general again.  Did you know he and your sister were an item forty years back?  That would give you a significant advantage, as he controls the forts guarding the mountain passes.

Oh I remember that vile old man. And every time I meet him, he gives me a sly wink as if I ever approved of the stunts he used to pull off. My father used to treat him like a brother, but not me. Do what you must - but don't tell me any sordid details.
Oh, you had best not invite her to visit for some time then - you know that sordid details are her favourite kind of details!
She hasn't changed one bit! Oh my dear sister used to...*mumbles drunkenly and tilts head too far to the side*
That is one of the best imitations of her I have ever seen!
Oh, how did that get there, you know they don't make these like they used to. *Hic* Where is that blasted court jester?
Smashing!  Oh, how lovely!  Do continue.
What brings you here today sir?
I come from far away and I bear startling news, my king.
Ok, I'm ready. Lay it on me.
Heathens from the North are marching towards the realm as we speak. Expect war within a fortnight.
This is the perfect time to try out my new war horse! Haha!
I'd not expect flippancy at such dire news, my king.
I understand your confusion but we will be victorious and no one will dare to bother us again. The realm will bow to me.
Understood. May the heathens return to their home in coffins.
Hopefully not too many of them. I will need new subjects.
Speaking of which, are you hiring? I get bored in the South. Nothing ever happens.
Why of coarse. I can always use more royal subjects. What skill do you have?
Well, all I really do is talk and pontificate. But kings look very distinguished when they have people around them pontificating.
You Hired! You don't take yourself very seriously and you are honest!
Oh, I forgot to mention. I'm also a master swordsman. Hobby of mine. Keeps me young.
What is with all this mess? How dirty are my knights?
My Liege! You bless me with your presence!!
Servant, has it always been this dirty here?
Yes, your highness... for years now, for as long as I have been here for sure
Well you need a raise for taking care of this. How many years have you been in my employ
My kind King! 5 years this end of the year, your highness
5 years of this filth... A raise is what you need. I will make sure you get 5 more coin a week
Oh blessed day!!!!!! I cannot believe you my most king King!! I could afford to finally eat once a day!!
You only eat once a day! Make sure that you get twice a day, by getting a meal here before you leave work every day
Good day. I am here reflecting on the coming war. And you?
I'm visiting my wife.
Oh of course. Such a sudden death. How long has it been?
Only two months. I'm trying to grieve so I can get back on the horse. I've got my eye on a certain chambermaid.
I see. It has not taken you long to move on. I am sure the queen is rolling over in her crypt.
Figures. It took getting her into a crypt to get some movement out of her. Naw, I kid. She was lovely. But she's gone, now.
It's time you got over this and thought more of the affairs of the kingdom. We must not lose focus. If we do you may not have anymore chambermaids to poke.
Yeah, what I need is a good war.
I am going out on a training session with The Mountain. You may come if you like.
Sure. Mind if I invite a certain chambermaid?
Of course I mind. Get your head out of the gutter. The upcoming war with the King Of The North is almost upon us.
Just think. One day, we'll occupy a couple of these crypts. Weird.
True enough. I 'm surprised the Queen didn
I've changed my mind. No war for me today. I need a nap.
Your Majesty this boy here is the apprentice. He has suggested this dagger.  It has gems on the handle.
I like this dagger. It is perfect for me, I am gonna keep it
This shield was made for your your Majesty as a gift of the blacksmith.  It is made of a new material that is said to have mystical properties.
What kind of mystical power are we talking. how can I trust him? I am the king and a lot of people wants to take my power

Ah...you jest your Majesty.  The blacksmith is your nephew and would not hurt you.  He has shielded you...literally... with his life in the past.  He chose this life and you have approved.  The mystical property's are that of fore site.
This is a pretty shield. I know you are right. But I am the king the most powerful men of this word. I have to be careful
I understand your majesty.  I guard you with my life.  This mace is of a good weight your majesty.
I don't want to hold it right know. thank you my brave knight you such a good person. We need more people like you in this kingdom
Your majesty flatters me. It is my great honor to protect you sire. Are we done here at the blacksmith's for the day?
The honor is mine. no not yet I want you to add diamonds to my crown.
I'm not sure that the blacksmith can do that here sir or even try your majesty.  I will entreat the blacksmith to come to the castle to do that work your majesty.
No I need you to do it know. it is a order. I have a party tonight and nobody can come to the castle
As you wish your majesty.  I will protect you against all harm.  I'll speak with the blacksmith now.
I have to leave now. people are waiting for me. I am going to come tomorrow and take a new sword.
I heard that you were looking for work in my kitchens...is this true?
No Your Highness. I am here to enjoy the great food and talk to the people about the Lord.
I see...I thought you were the chef I was to interview.  Very well...come and look at the food and see what you would like.
Thank you Your Highness. Will you be joining us or do you have kingdom business to deal with?
I will be joining you.  I would like to support the work of the Lord anyway I can for my kingdom.  Now...look at the fresh meats here and  your meal will be cooked fresh!
This pheasant looks divine. I shall have it.
Cook!  Save this pheasant for our parishioner and use the garlic wine sauce as well!  Is that satisfactory to you?
It is Your Highness. I look forward to it. Perhaps we can have some of this wine and speak of the Lord together?
I would love that.  Do you prefer a white wine, a red, or a cabernet?
I prefer the red variety. A sweet one if you have it. I was just reading a verse in the bible. It made me think of the passing of the queen.
Let me arrange to have my butler bring the wine up to the court so we can sit and be away from this odorous meat. What was the verse?
If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord. The queen truly believed in this.
She did and I as well.  Its such a comfort to know that we live life to glorify God and we have our eternal reward to look forward to.  Praise God!
Praise God. Amen Your Highness.
Hello. Are you hiding here?
'Ello your majesty, just heading up to check on your reserves.
Oh good! These tunnels are excellent for doing so. Are we doing alright on everything? How is the wine supply?

After that last party you threw, looks like you're almost out.  We have a shipment rolling in tomorrow evening, and should have enough to last till then.  What are you doing down here?  I don't normally see you in the tunnels.
Checking them out, it's always good to make sure the tunnels are still clear and ready for use. To make sure they aren't being used by anyone that shouldn't be here, of course.
Too Right too right, always on the lookout.  Its why you're such a good King.  Need anything special beyond the normal wine?  I know the Queen's birthday is just 'round the corner.
Ah yes. I am having her a new gown commissioned, but she does like a particular honey mead with blackberries. It would make her birthday all the more special if you could get a keg of it for her.
Absolutely, its just the right season for that mead to finish its fermenting.  In fact, I know I have a couple kegs of the best stuff in the Kingdom, I'll bring it up here in the next couple weeks!

Haha! Good! She will be extremely pleased with this. I do try to spoil her. When she's happy, she has the gardens made into the most beautiful places during the seasons. If she's not, they seem lackluster and makes me sad.

Completely understand, my wife's the same way.  Happy wife happy life I always say.  I normally wouldn't bring this up, but I've been hearing some malcontents down at the tavern. Best be careful over the next few weeks for your food majesty.  I have heard rumors.
Oh dear! What is happening at the tavern that causes discontent? I will have to be very careful. How is your wife, by the bye?

She's lovely these days.  I'm not quiet sure sir, just know that a few folks are upset with you for some reason.  Could be out of towners, I don't recognize many of them.  Just be on your guard sir, 'sall I'm saying.

I will do so, thank you for your honesty. I will reward this honesty of course. I am always too happy to take care of staff. A happy staff makes the castle a happier place. -- And I get poisoned a lot less.
Yes sir, 'tis why we love you.  You take care of us, and we you your highness.
My Queen! I, uh, I wasn't expecting you here. At this hour..
My King! To say you cannot see me here in a library? I can read of course! But I will say that I am getting tired of this place and all these....books.
I would never accuse you of such a thing, my sweet. But yes, I'm sure this place would seem quite dull to you. Perhaps you would rather we take a walk in the gardens?

Of course. That sound so much more romantic and lovely, however, I am in need of a new cushion for my throne....I saw how you had a feather pillow on yours! How come I cannot have one just like yours! Mine is made out of....leather! Do you expect me to read and learn how to create one?

Of course not, though I remind you that it was you that requested a leather seat for your throne. Do you not remember, dearest? We brought in all the leatherworkers in the land, until we found one to your liking.

I don't like it anymore! It reminds me of all the leather back books here in this filthy attic. There is no sunlight or windows here, just pure the smell of mold and paper! Didn't you say that my throne would be forever comfortable like this brown matching chair!?
I... I did promise that. Of course I did. Now, now don't cry, you said you wanted a feather chair, what kind of feather would make you happy.
A quill feather chair with silk linen wrapped around it would be nice! My King you are too kind if you can make this happen! Oh how embarrassing to have this conversation if front of our maid...
You know.. we have a pretty bomb ass kingdom
Yes I know that's true!
Look at all we have here. The rivers to the west, plains to the east. Is there anything more you could ever want?
I could use a new piece of jewelry!
Queen Nompumelelo! I know we are wed but do not think I won't have you charged for such foolishness.
I didn't realize you liked jewelry as much as me King!
I am nothing without my crown, of course I would try to defend it.
What about this then?
I offer you any land you want and you instead steal a gilded stick. Foolish woman
Well I did want a nice piece of jewelry....
Then demand it from the people! Taking from your king risks your own hide! Demand your due as queen.
Well take your scepter back too!
No. It's tainted now. It can lay on the ground while I find myself a new queen. One with more respect for the proper authority
Oh king, please forgive me!
Good day, priest
Good day. Would you like to make a confession.
Yes I would, thank you
Whenever you are ready my child, your highness.
May I ask you something? Something about the villagers?
This is hardly the time or place, but I will make exception for you your highness.
What do the villagers think of me? I fear I have not been the wisest king of the land...

Well your highness. To be honest, the villagers find you a little eccentric. They feel that you may not be the smartest king ever in the land, but they all know that you have a good heart and always do what you feel is best for your people.

Do you really mean so? I've had many restless nights mourning my beloved Elizabeth and wanting to make this kingdom prosper, but I feel as though it's not enough. I try to be brave most times, but right now I feel as though I'm at my ends
You should be proud of the job you have done. I know the people of your kingdom are. I dont know one villager who wouldnt lay down their life for you.

Thank you, priest. One more thing. Is it a sin, or against God's holy word, to lead all theses men into battle knowing how little chance they have with surviving? While I don't like admitting it, the other kingdom against ours is way too powerful.
Well your highness, I think if it was for improper reasons it would be against god. Since we did not start this war and they wish to enslave our people we have no other option.
You're right. Sorry for this inconvenience priest, and thank you for being helpful ears.
Anytime your highness. Keep your head up and remember your people and god are behind you no matter the outcome.
How are you today daughter?
I am wonderful father. I think I will make a good queen for our kingdom someday. Don't you?
Oh most certainly, you did come from my seed after all.
And I don't need to marry a prince. I can do it all without a man. He will just get in my way.
Why do you think something like that?
No offense to you father but there are many stories of ugly rotten princes with heart as dark as coal who treat their Queen like a paycheck from the Queens dowry.
Oh my dear, yes there are plenty not fit to be called men, just be sure to avoid boys.
You will make sure we find a good one right? I know eventually I cannot avoid it.
Well that is the idea, often the decision falls with the lady you see though.
Sure wish I wasn't stuck with a prince. I think the royal knight is quite charming and handsome.
Yes but he is not of noble standing, the people would never accept such a thing.
True....Oh well.
You know how fussy they can be when it comes to status.
Yes...They talk if I even wear the wrong color dress, or if my ruffles are out of place..
Why are you holding me captive? I have done nothing wrong!
It is a past time of mine, I mean I am the king I do what I want.
But all I have done is support my poor family?
It's okay I am paying them to cover your absence. Say you don't know any jokes do you?
Jokes? How can I joke at a time like this! I'm in a dungeon filled with filth. Do you think this is a joking matter?!?!
I want to hear a joke, just make it happen.
Why should you stand in the corner if it gets cold?
Tell me why.
Because it's always 90 degrees!
Well then...I see what you did there.
You like? Now let me go!
You seem a bit demanding, I require one more joke then I will make it happen. I am a fair king after all.
Did you hear about the crook who stole a calendar? He got twelve months.
Excellent, fine I will let you go. But no whining to the townsfolk.
My love what do you think of the garden?
Oh, my King, my husband.  It is lovely.  It is so peaceful here; so much life.  Have you seen the rainbow the gods have given us today?
Yes it's almost as lovely as your sparkling eyes. Tell me do you remember when we first met?
I was so nervous.  My parent
Hahaha yes. I don't think your father was too fond of me first

I don't believe he was either but you won him over with your love for me.  My nerves melted and we shortly had our first son.  Then our second! I don't think there is a luckier lady in this fair land than I.
Surely not. No woman could ever compared to my lovely Queen. Strong, bold, daring, but submissive to me. I love it.
All the ladies giggle at me.  But they don't know our love, my King.  It's as pure as these birds we hear singing.
They are just jealous of what we have. Don't let them get to you haha!
Never, my love.  How can I? With this beautiful land and our beautiful sons.
Ah yes! I've been thinking... would you want to try to have a daughter soon?
YES! I would love to have a little princess running around.
Right here in the garden?! Oh my you're bold!
We are only surrounded by what the gods' have given us. Please, my king. Take me now.
-scitters around the prison floor-
Ew! A filthy spider! What are you doing here?
This is a prison?
I specifically told the guards to kill any spiders here.
Seems a little over the top considering where we are.
You do not understand, I will not have creatures like you in my castle, no matter if it is the throne room or the dungeons.
A bit of a grumpy king are you not, I don't even eat the bugs I catch cause I am a nice guy.
How bout you start eating some more bugs then, then I'll think of letting you go.
So all you want is for me to eat bugs?
Yes, keep the dungeons clean.
I will do what I can then.
Thank you, spider.
I'm just glad to not have anyone trying to kill me.
I will be sure to tell my guards to leave you alone.
How can I help you today your majesty?
Will you buff this for me, it looks a little dirty
I will absolutely your majesty!
Did you check for me to see what they are serving for the banquet tonight?
They are serving the finest duck in the entire land!
Duck, it better not be raw like last time. And tell them to save the foi gras for me.
I will definitely let them know your majesty!
What do your think of this cape, I'm not sure about the color.
It looks magnificent on you!!
Do you think they will think of Blood with the red color?
I think they will think of how you are such a great leader!
Ok, It is rather striking, I don't want to gain any nick names like William the Bloody
I know they will not think of such things from you your majesty!
I don't know....I've done some things
Has there been any intruders?
